1a6db50b.title: Lead Technical Program Manager, ITC
1a6db50b.description:
**Who You’ll Work With**
 You will be part of the Supply Chain \& Planning Technology (SCPT) Portfolio \& Operations team, helping establish and mature SCPT’s operational footprint in Nike’s India Technology Center (ITC). You will report to the Director, SCPT ITC Operations and work in close partnership with Domain Portfolio \& Operations Leaders to facilitate delivery within the Sub\-Domain you support. You will collaborate directly with Product and Engineering leaders, Program Operations peers, Portfolio team and Initiative Program Managers, across locations in India, the US, and Europe.
   

  

**Who We Are Looking For**
 We are looking for a hands\-on operator with experience in a scaled environment who can help teams predictably plan, execute and continuously improve how work gets done.
   

  

 The right person brings strong program operations discipline, practical agile delivery experience, and the ability to turn data and metrics into clear insights that help leaders make informed decisions. They are comfortable partnering in a matrixed environment, influencing through trust and clarity, and improving operating standards without adding unnecessary process.
   

  

* 7\+ years of experience in program operations, technical program management, delivery operations, agile delivery, or a related technology operations role.
* Bachelor’s degree or equivalent qualification in a relevant field, or equivalent combination of education, experience, and training.
* Demonstrated experience supporting agile teams and delivery practices, including practical use of tools such as Jira and Confluence.
* Experience creating dashboards, reports, and communicating operating insights that provide transparency into team health, progress, risks, and delivery effectiveness.
* Strong facilitation skills, including experience supporting planning rhythms such as quarterly planning, retrospectives, and operational readouts.
* Proven ability to partner with Product, Engineering, and Operations leaders to identify friction, clarify accountability, and improve ways of working.
* Comfort operating across geographies, cultures, and time zones, with a collaborative style that builds connection and alignment across distributed teams.
* Curiosity and practical experience using automation or AI\-enabled tools to simplify work, improve consistency, and scale operational practices.
* Preferred: experience with supply chain and/or planning technology delivery.


**What You’ll Work On**
 You will champion delivery excellence across Supply Chain \& Planning Technology by driving consistent operating standards, delivery frameworks, and execution practices. Your work will provide clear visibility into team health, program execution, and operational effectiveness so leaders and teams can make better decisions, address risks sooner, and continuously improve how teams deliver.
   

  

**Sub\-Domain Delivery Partnership —** 
 Operate in close partnership through a dotted line relationship with the Domain Portfolio \& Operations Leader to facilitate delivery within the sub\-domain and help translate operating standards into practical execution.
   

  

**Agile Tools and Standards —** 
 Drive consistent use of agile tools, program standards, and delivery practices, including Jira, Confluence, and related operating mechanisms.
   

  

**Quarterly Planning Readiness —** 
 Support the quarterly planning process and facilitation by ensuring teams are prepared, aligned, and set up for successful execution.
   

  

**Dashboards, Reporting, and Insights —** 
 Create and maintain dashboards and reporting that provide transparency into team performance, progress, and risks; use insights to highlight gaps and drive improvements.
   

  

**Operational Improvement —** 
 Actively surface inefficiencies or gaps in squad operations and work with teams to implement practical improvements that increase delivery effectiveness and predictability.
   

  

**Change Management —** 
 Lead adoption and change management of new tools, processes, and ways of working so teams understand what is changing, why it matters, and how to apply it.
   

  

**Product and Engineering Partnership —** 
 Co\-create and collaborate with Product and Engineering partners to evolve squad operating standards and agile ways of working.
   

  

**AI\-Enabled Ways of Working —** 
 Identify and drive operational and process improvements that increase efficiency, consistency, and effectiveness across SCPT, using AI\-enabled tools to experiment, learn, and scale what works.
   

  

**Program Delivery Support —** 
 Support program delivery within the sub\-domain on an ad\-hoc basis in alignment with the Domain Portfolio \& Operations Leader.
   

  

**Initiative Program Partnership —** 
 Partner with Initiative Program Managers, where applicable, to facilitate delivery and support program objectives.
   

  

**Local Execution for Cross\-Domain Work —** 
 Drive and support local execution of cross\-domain or SCPT\-wide programs during local business hours.

40cc36ab.title: Technical Program Manager (Insurance Domain)
40cc36ab.description:
**A Reputed Insurtech MNC is hiring for Program Manager. Insurance Domain Experience Mandatory.** 




  





**Experience: 18\+ years** 




**Location: Noida/ Gurgaon** 









**Role Purpose** 




**The Program Manager is responsible for governing and coordinating multiple customer implementations and support engagements, ensuring successful delivery of Insurance products and solutions across customers, teams, and delivery streams.** 




**The role provides portfolio\-level oversight across implementation, configuration, integration, quality assurance, data validation, cloud deployment, and support functions while driving delivery excellence, customer satisfaction, operational scalability, and successful business outcomes. The Program Manager works closely with Technical Project Managers, Implementation Architects, Delivery Leads, Product Teams, and Customer Stakeholders to ensure delivery commitments are met** 
 .
 



  





**Key Responsibilities** 



* Govern and oversee multiple customer implementations and support engagements.
* Manage program\-level planning, resource allocation, capacity management, and delivery forecasting.
* Ensure successful delivery of customer commitments, implementation milestones, support obligations, and business outcomes.
* Monitor overall program health, risks, dependencies, budgets, and delivery performance across customers.
* Partner with Technical Project Managers to ensure successful execution of customer implementation projects.
* Work closely with Implementation Architects, Lead Business Analysts, Lead Configurators, Lead Integration, Lead QA, AI \& Data Validation Specialists, and Support Delivery Leads to align delivery activities.
* Oversee implementation and adoption of workflow automation solutions leveraging technologies such as n8n, Camunda, Apache Camel, and related orchestration platforms.
* Coordinate environment readiness, deployment planning, release activities, production cutovers, and support transitions.
* Act as the primary escalation point for delivery, support, resource, and customer management issues.
* Drive customer governance meetings, steering committee reviews, executive reporting, and stakeholder communications.
* Track and report implementation progress, delivery performance, resource utilization, risks, and customer satisfaction metrics.
* Ensure smooth transition from implementation to production support and operational ownership.
* Support implementation planning, prioritization, staffing, and delivery optimization initiatives.
* Drive continuous improvement initiatives across delivery, implementation, support, and operational processes.
* Collaborate with Product, Engineering, and Leadership teams to align customer needs with platform capabilities and product roadmap priorities.



  





**Required Skills \& Experience** 



* Bachelor's degree in computer science, Engineering, Information Systems, Business, or related field.
* 18–21 years of experience in technical program management, delivery management, implementation management, or professional services leadership.
* Strong experience in the Property \& Casualty (P\&C) Insurance domain; Knowledge of Commercial Lines and Specialty Insurance, considered an advantage.
* Experience managing multiple concurrent enterprise software implementations and customer engagements.
* Strong understanding of enterprise software implementation and delivery lifecycles.
* Good understanding of workflow automation platforms, configurable enterprise applications, and implementation\-driven delivery models.
* Good understanding of BPMN\-based workflow automation, business process orchestration platforms such as Camunda, Flowable, Appian or similar technologies.
* Understanding enterprise integrations, APIs, data migration, and cloud\-based solution deployments.
* Understanding of cloud hosting models, environment management, deployment planning, and release coordination across Azure environments.
* Ability to manage delivery dependencies across workflows, integrations, business rules, forms, cloud environments, data validation, and customer onboarding activities.
* Experience managing cross\-functional delivery teams comprising Architects, Business Analysts, Configurators, Developers, QA, Data Validation, and Support teams.
* Strong understanding of Agile delivery, release management, customer onboarding, and support transition processes.
* Experience managing customer escalations, delivery risks, budgets, and program dependencies.
* Strong understanding of resource planning, capacity management, utilization tracking, and delivery forecasting.
* Excellent stakeholder management, executive communication, leadership, and decision\-making skills.
* Proven experience working with insurance carriers and clients across North America or Europe.



  





**Desired Skills** 



* Experience with intelligent automation, document processing, AI\-enabled solutions, or workflow\-driven platforms.
* Experience working with SaaS platforms, InsurTech solutions, or enterprise workflow automation products.
* PMP, PgMP, SAFe, PRINCE2, or equivalent program management certification.

4ba72c17.title: Solution Architect (Java OR Python Application Architecture & GitHub Copilot)
4ba72c17.description:
**Role description**  


Job Description



**Solution Architect \- Java, Python \& AI Engineering**



**Job Title**

  


Solution Architect  



**Experience**

  


12\+ years overall; 5\+ years in architecture or technical leadership

  


**Location**

  


India / Client Location, as applicable

  

**Employment Type**

  


Full\-time



  

**Role Overview**



We are seeking an experienced Solution Architect with strong hands\-on expertise in Java, Python, and AI\-enabled software engineering. The architect will define scalable application and platform architectures, guide engineering teams, and accelerate delivery through GitHub Copilot and agentic AI practices. The role combines enterprise architecture, modern application development, cloud\-native engineering, technical governance, and customer\-facing advisory responsibilities.



Proven experience with GitHub Copilot and agentic AI solutions is mandatory. Exposure to GitHub administration and at least one major cloud platform is preferred.


**Key Responsibilities Architecture \& Technical Leadership**


* Define end\-to\-end solution architectures for enterprise applications and digital platforms using Java, Python, APIs, microservices, event\-driven patterns, and cloud\-native services.


* Create architecture blueprints, reference patterns, technology standards, non\-functional requirements, and implementation roadmaps.


* Lead technical discovery, architecture reviews, design decisions, proof\-of\-concepts, and engineering governance across the delivery lifecycle.


* Provide hands\-on technical direction to development teams, resolve complex design challenges, and ensure alignment with security, performance, scalability, resilience, and maintainability goals.


* Assess existing application landscapes and recommend modernization, re\-engineering, integration, and migration approaches.


**Java Engineering**


* Architect scalable Java solutions using modern Java, Spring Boot, RESTful services, microservices, messaging, persistence frameworks, and automated testing practices.


* Define standards for application layering, API design, exception handling, observability, configuration, dependency management, and secure coding.


* Guide performance engineering, JVM optimization, concurrency, distributed transaction patterns, and production troubleshooting.


* Promote reusable frameworks, engineering accelerators, and quality gates for enterprise Java delivery.


**Python \& AI Engineering**


* Architect Python\-based services, automation components, data\-processing workloads, AI integrations, and intelligent developer tooling.


* Design modular and production\-ready Python solutions using appropriate API frameworks, testing practices, packaging standards, asynchronous processing, and observability.


* Define solution patterns for integrating large language models, enterprise data sources, retrieval\-augmented generation, tool use, and AI\-enabled workflows.


* Guide model and service evaluation, prompt design, grounding, responsible AI controls, quality validation, security, operational monitoring, and cost\-aware implementation.


* Collaborate with data, security, platform, and product teams to transition AI prototypes into governed, supportable production solutions.


**GitHub Copilot \& Agentic AI**


* Lead adoption of GitHub Copilot across Java and Python engineering teams, including use\-case identification, enablement, workflow integration, coding standards, and measurable adoption outcomes.


* Design and implement agentic AI workflows that can reason over context, invoke approved tools, coordinate multi\-step tasks, and operate within defined human oversight and security boundaries.


* Establish patterns for AI\-assisted coding, code explanation, refactoring, unit\-test generation, documentation, code review, troubleshooting, and software delivery automation.


* Define guardrails for prompt handling, sensitive data protection, access control, auditability, human\-in\-the\-loop approvals, responsible AI, and output validation.


* Evaluate Copilot and agentic AI solutions through structured pilots, engineering feedback, quality indicators, productivity measures, risk assessments, and continuous improvement plans.


**DevSecOps, Platform \& Cloud**


* Define CI/CD, build, test, security, release, and deployment patterns for Java and Python workloads using GitHub\-centric engineering practices.


* Promote Infrastructure as Code, containerization, Kubernetes, automated policy enforcement, software supply\-chain security, and environment standardization.


* Architect deployment models for public cloud, private cloud, hybrid, or multi\-cloud environments based on business and technical requirements.


* Collaborate with platform, SRE, operations, and security teams to establish monitoring, logging, tracing, reliability, recovery, and operational support standards.



Stakeholder \& Delivery Management


* Partner with customer stakeholders, product owners, enterprise architects, security leaders, and engineering teams to translate business needs into implementable architecture.


* Facilitate architecture workshops, technical assessments, solution walkthroughs, and decision forums.


* Prepare architecture documents, diagrams, solution options, estimates, risk registers, technical proposals, and executive presentations.


* Support pre\-sales, solution shaping, effort estimation, delivery planning, technical interviews, and capability development.



Required Qualifications \& Experience


* 12\+ years of overall IT experience, including substantial experience in solution architecture, application architecture, technical leadership, or enterprise software delivery.


* Strong hands\-on expertise in Java and the Spring ecosystem, with experience architecting enterprise applications, APIs, microservices, and distributed systems.


* Strong Python experience for application development, automation, AI integration, or data\-processing solutions.


* Demonstrated experience using GitHub Copilot in software engineering workflows and enabling its adoption across development teams.


* Demonstrated experience designing or implementing agentic AI solutions, including tool integration, orchestration, grounding, guardrails, and human oversight.


* Good understanding of generative AI, large language models, retrieval\-augmented generation, embeddings, prompt engineering, evaluation, responsible AI, and AI security considerations.


* Experience with software architecture principles, design patterns, API management, event\-driven architecture, relational and NoSQL data stores, caching, messaging, and integration patterns.


* Experience defining CI/CD, DevSecOps, automated testing, code quality, security scanning, observability, and release governance practices.

03c366d9.title: Senior TPM, Risk and Compliance Solutions (RCS)
03c366d9.description:
**DESCRIPTION**
---------------


We're seeking an experienced Technical Program Manager to lead critical programs within Risk and Compliance Solutions (RCS).
  

RCS serves as a crucial safeguard for Amazon's buyers, brands, and selling partners while ensuring business teams meet their regulatory obligations. Operating under the Three Lines of Defense (3LoD) model, RCS functions as the second line of defense, providing specialized oversight, monitoring, and expertise while setting policies and procedures that guide Amazon's compliance framework.  

RCS's mission is to leverage specialist industry insights and Amazon's unique approach to scale through technology, delighting customers through tailored compliance solutions. Our work spans multiple critical areas, including:  

* Enabling Amazon's financial services expansion through streamlined license acquisition
* Managing existing business risks across the organization
* Delivering comprehensive governance, risk, and assurance services
* Developing innovative solutions like Compliance as a Service (CaaS)
* Transforming compliance operations into a proactive, intelligence\-led framework

  

Role Overview:  

We're seeking a Senior Technical Program Manager (TPM) to lead scalable technology solutions delivery that transform how Amazon approaches compliance and risk management. This role is critical for RCS's mission to scale compliance operations through technology, reduce manual processes, and enable Amazon's global expansion while maintaining regulatory compliance.  

At Amazon, we hire the best minds in technology to innovate and build on behalf of our customers. The focus we have on our customers is why we are one of the world's most beloved brands – customer obsession is part of our company DNA. Our TPM use technology to drive complex programs and get to see the impact of their work first\-hand. The challenges you'll solve are big and influence millions of customers, sellers, and products around the world.
  

We are looking for individuals who are passionate about driving alignment and execution leveraging their technical domain knowledge, strong program management fundamentals, and trusted partnerships while managing ambiguity and the pace of a company where development cycles are measured in weeks, not years.  

  

Key job responsibilities  

* Lead complex technical programs across RCS's end\-to\-end regulatory compliance applications and regulatory reporting
* Drive the implementation of AI/ML\-powered compliance solutions, including automated horizon scanning, predictive control frameworks, and automated controls testing.
* Manage cross\-functional programs that integrate GenAI capabilities across RCS.
* Partner with engineering teams and business stakeholders to transform manual compliance processes into automated, scalable solutions
* Coordinate with global regulatory teams to ensure technology solutions meet compliance requirements
* Drive technical integration initiatives with other Amazon teams to leverage core services
* Establish and track program metrics that demonstrate compliance effectiveness and operational efficiency
* Lead programs that enable streamlined license acquisition for Amazon's financial services expansion
**BASIC QUALIFICATIONS**
------------------------

* 7\+ years of working directly with engineering teams experience
* 5\+ years of technical product or program management experience
* 3\+ years of software development experience
* 5\+ years of technical program management working directly with software engineering teams experience
* Experience managing programs across cross functional teams, building processes and coordinating release schedules

**PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS**
----------------------------

* 5\+ years of project management disciplines including scope, schedule, budget, quality, along with risk and critical path management experience
* Experience managing projects across cross functional teams, building sustainable processes and coordinating release schedules
* Experience defining KPI's/SLA's used to drive multi\-million dollar businesses and reporting to senior leadership
* Bachelor's degree in engineering, computer science or equivalent

  

Our inclusive culture empowers Amazonians to deliver the best results for our customers. If you have a disability and need a workplace accommodation or adjustment during the application and hiring process, including support for the interview or onboarding process, please visit https://amazon.jobs/content/en/how\-we\-hire/accommodations for more information. If the country/region you’re applying in isn’t listed, please contact your Recruiting Partner.

 Clarus Advisers is a professional advisory and consulting firm that helps organizations with strategic business and technology solutions. It focuses on delivering specialized expertise to support clients in achieving their business and operational goals.
   

  

 Position Overview
   

  

 The position is responsible for designing and implementing large\-scale cloud infrastructure, networking, and automation solutions for AI/HPC environments. The role involves working closely with customers, partners, and internal teams to deliver scalable infrastructure solutions while providing technical expertise in system design, networking, troubleshooting, and automation.
   

  

**Responsibilities**
* Develop and maintain continuous integration and delivery pipelines .
* Develop tooling to automate deployment and management of large\-scale infrastructure environments, to automate operational monitoring and alerting, and to enable self\-service consumption of resources.
* Deploy monitoring solutions for the servers, network and storage.
* Perform troubleshooting bottom up from bare metal, operating system, software stack and application level.
* Being a technical resource, develop, re\-define and document standard methodologies to share with internal teams Support Research \& Development activities and engage in POCs/POVs for future improvements .


**Skills \& Experience**
* BS/MS/PhD or equivalent experience in Computer Science, Data Science, Electrical/Computer Engineering, Physics, Mathematics, other Engineering fields with at least 8 years work or research experience in networking fundamentals, TCP/IP stack, and data center architecture.
* 5\+ Years of Design, implement and maintain large scale HPC/AI clusters with monitoring, logging and alerting Manage Linux job/workload schedulers and orchestration tools.
* Knowledge of HPC and AI solution technologies from CPU’s and GPU’s to high speed interconnects and supporting software.
* Direct design, implementation and management experience with cloud computing platforms (e.g. AWS, Azure, Google Cloud).
* Experience with job scheduling workloads and orchestration technologies such as Slurm, Kubernetes and Singularity.
* Excellent knowledge of Windows and Linux (Redhat/CentOS and Ubuntu) networking (sockets, firewalld, iptables, wireshark, etc.) and internals, ACLs and OS level security protection and common protocols e.g. TCP, DHCP, DNS, etc.
* Experience with multiple storage solutions such as Lustre, GPFS, zfs and xfs. Familiarity with newer and emerging storage technologies.
* Python programming and bash scripting experience.
* Comfortable with automation and configuration management tools including Jenkins, Ansible, Puppet/Chef, etc.
* Deep knowledge of Networking Protocols like InfiniBand, Ethernet Deep understanding and experience with virtual systems (for example VMware, Hyper\-V, KVM, or Citrix).
* Strong written, verbal, and listening skills in English are critical.

aac80d06.title: Digital Transformation Advisor & Delivery Lead
aac80d06.description:
Our number of assignments are growing – we need to strengthen our team!
   

  

 ‍
   

  

**Qualifications**
 Ability to understand complex systems \& solutions and see the bigger picture, identify what is needed and how to achieve it, while still have a desire to dig into the details and solve challenges at the core. You need be comfortable working both independently and in teams, with our clients, your colleagues and partners – on site and remotely/online.
   

  

 We are looking for candidates with wide experience from digital transformation programmes and/or digital product projects within IT and hopefully within OT domains. You need to understand both the business, data, processes and the technology underpinning the digital transformation from a business and architecture point of view. You thrive as working in our hub interconnecting these, and you are responsible delivering our digital transformation projects and at the same time provide our clients with the best digital advice. The spokes connected to our consists of resources and specialists from btwn, the client and our partners.
   

  

 btwn´s value proposition within digital transformation has a wide span from a to z, and can include initial digital assessments and screenings, Cloud \& data platforms, APIs, BI solutions and automation to name some.
   

  

 We will find it interesting if you also have experience from sales processes involving digital transformation and/or its themes, including working out commercial aspects, quotations/bids and client presentations. Also, technical experience with cloud and data will be valued.
   

  

* Bachelor’s degree required. Minimum five years of relevant work experience in the above areas.
* Good communication skills, both orally and in writing (English, Norwegian)
* Willingness to travel and work with client at their premises.


**RESPONSIBILITY**
 btwn seeks a highly motivated new colleague that can confidently take on responsibility in our digital transformation project delivery, also as our client advisor. As part of our digital transformation team you will be expected to provide input and expectations to our value proposition, partner follow\-up and engagement decisions.

f8c5c4a9.description:
**Job Title:** AWS Infrastructure Cloud Engineer (Terraform \+ Python Automation)
  
**City:** Pune
  
**State/Province:** Maharashtra
  
**Posting Start Date:** 8/18/26
  
**Wipro Limited (NYSE:** WIT, BSE: 507685, NSE: WIPRO) is a leading technology services and consulting company focused on building innovative solutions that address clients’ most complex digital transformation needs. Leveraging our holistic portfolio of capabilities in consulting, design, engineering, and operations, we help clients realize their boldest ambitions and build future\-ready, sustainable businesses. With over 230,000 employees and business partners across 65 countries, we deliver on the promise of helping our customers, colleagues, and communities thrive in an ever\-changing world. For additional information, visit us at www.wipro.com.
  
  

AWS Infrastructure Cloud Engineer (Terraform \+ Python Automation)
  
  

**Location:** Hyderabad
  
  

**Notice :** Immedaite joiners
  
  

**Budget :** 23LPA mx
  
  

**Band:** B3
  
  

EXP\- 6 to 10 years
  
  

**Locaton:** Pune/Hyd
  
  

Role purpose
  
  

You’ll build and run the AWS infrastructure “base layer” using Infrastructure as Code (Terraform), and create automation (preferably Python) to make provisioning, configuration, and operations repeatable, secure, and fast. You’ll work closely with architects, security, and application teams to deliver reliable cloud platforms and CI/CD\-enabled infrastructure.
  
  

Key responsibilities
  
  

* Build AWS infrastructure foundations using Terraform (networking, IAM, compute, storage, logging/monitoring, security baselines).
* Translate high\-level architecture into reusable Terraform modules and environment patterns (dev/test/prod).
* Implement automation using Python (preferred) for operational tasks such as provisioning helpers, config validation, tagging/governance checks, drift detection, report generation, etc.
* Own CI/CD integration for infrastructure deployments.
* Use Ansible for configuration management and post\-provisioning tasks where appropriate.
* Administer and troubleshoot Linux\-based systems used in cloud workloads and build agents.
* Ensure infrastructure meets security, resiliency, and cost\-management standards (least privilege, encryption, logging, backups, HA).
* Collaborate with stakeholders to define standards: naming/tagging, module versioning, branching strategy, and release controls.
* Troubleshoot incidents and deployment issues; perform root cause analysis and implement preventive improvements.
* Produce and maintain technical documentation (runbooks, module READMEs, onboarding guides).


Required skills (must\-have)
  
  

* Terraform: strong hands\-on experience building AWS infrastructure; modules, state management, remote backends, workspaces/environment separation, lifecycle patterns.
* AWS: solid understanding of core services (VPC, subnets, routing, IAM, EC2, ALB/NLB, Auto Scaling, S3, KMS, CloudWatch, CloudTrail, Security Groups/NACLs).
* Linux: operating system fundamentals, networking basics, troubleshooting, permissions, system services.
* Ansible: playbooks/roles, inventories, variables, idempotent configuration patterns.
* Jenkins: pipeline creation/maintenance; integrating Terraform workflows; secrets handling and approvals.
* Scripting: Python preferred (any one scripting language acceptable); ability to write maintainable automation and tooling (APIs, CLI utilities, JSON/YAML handling).


Good to have
  
  

* GCP: exposure to GCP services and comparable IaC patterns (multi\-cloud awareness).
* Container fundamentals (Docker/Kubernetes) and cloud\-native observability practices.
* Experience with security tooling or policy\-as\-code (e.g., Sentinel/OPA), if used in your environment.

͏

**Experience:** 5\-8 Years .

ab6c7e3b.description:
**About Helfie:** 




 Helfie is on a mission to redefine global preventative healthcare. We’re pioneering an entirely new operating system for human health – empowering billons with instant, affordable health checks and AI\-driven insights. Our vision is to build trust, drive organic engagement, and make preventative healthcare a reality for all 8 billion of us.
 



  





 Join us as we revolutionise the healthcare landscape and make early detection and prevention accessible to everyone.
 



  





**About the role:** 




 We are seeking an experienced Application Architect to own the end\-to\-end application architecture of the Helfie platform — spanning our native mobile apps (iOS Swift, Android Kotlin), the Helfie Hub backend, our Azure\-hosted services layer, and the integration fabric that connects them to six production ML inference endpoints and our generative AI assistant architecture.
 



  





 You will translate Helfie's enterprise architecture into concrete, buildable application designs and govern them through our gate\-based delivery pipeline from Architecture to Production.
 



  





**Key responsibilities:** 



* Provide technical leadership and direction across the full application development lifecycle.
* Design end\-to\-end application architecture that balances performance, scalability, availability, and technical debt.
* Lead design reviews, walkthroughs, and solution validation activities.
* Identify and resolve issues impacting architecture, application integrity, and platform simplicity.
* Support engineering teams with problem diagnosis and root cause analysis.
* Contribute to design, technical analysis, and software delivery where required.
* Drive service optimisation, modelling, and performance outcomes.
* Lead and contribute to agile ceremonies and cross\-team forums.
* Proven ability to set technical direction and bring engineering, product, and compliance stakeholders along with clear, well\-argued design artefacts.
* Experience running architecture governance — gate reviews, ADRs, and trade\-off analysis — without slowing delivery.
* Strong mentoring instincts; you raise the bar of teams you work with.



  





**Skills \& experience:** 



* 8\+ years in software engineering, with at least 4 years in a formal Architect role on production systems.
* Proven experience in data engineering and data analytics, or closely related technical disciplines.
* Deep expertise in application architecture, including large\-scale analytics systems, distributed data processing, and real\-time architectures.
* Hands\-on experience with domain modelling and Domain\-Driven Design, maintaining clean separation between domain, application, and infrastructure layers.
* Demonstrated ability to design AI and advanced analytics workloads, with strong familiarity with modern AI patterns and AI\-driven applications.
* Track record partnering with Solutions Architects on the application–platform boundary: workload identity, secrets management, event and messaging contracts, and service design patterns.



  





**Benefits:** 



* Competitive salary and comprehensive benefits package.
* Opportunities for professional growth and creative development.
* Flexible working hours with remote work options.
* A vibrant, collaborative team environment.



  





**Equal opportunity statement** 




 Helfie.ai is an Equal Opportunity Employer. We will not discriminate on the basis of age, disability, sex, race, religion or belief, gender reassignment, marriage / civil partnership, pregnancy or sexual orientation. We encourage applications from a wide range of candidates and selection for roles will be based on individual merit alone.

 Cloud \& Platform Expertise

4b5c192d.title: Course5i - AI Solutions Architect
4b5c192d.description:
**About C5i**
 Founded in 2000, C5i enables organisations to make the most effective strategic and tactical moves relating to their customers, markets and competition, at the pace the digital business world demands. We build AI products : Agent5i, our enterprise agentic AI system; Compete, digital shelf analytics for brands selling through retail; Incivus, creative effectiveness for marketing teams; and Synthetic Audiences, virtual respondents for research teams who need an answer faster than a panel can return one. Each has its own users, roadmap, release cycle and stack today, running across Azure, AWS and GCP.
   

  

**What We Seek**
 You sit between what the products need to do and which method will actually do it. This is an internal product seat : no customer calendar, no pre\-sales. The work is generative and agentic by default. Agent decomposition, tool and function contracts, orchestration, context assembly, retrieval design, guardrails and evaluation. Fine\-tuning and domain\-specific small models where they beat prompting on cost or accuracy. Knowing which to reach for, and recognising when none of them is the answer, is most of the job.
   

  

 Every capability as a feature resolves to one of three things : a pattern the products already support, something worth building once and using across all four, or a no. You make that call before engineering commits to it. Getting it wrong in the generous direction is how a product ends up with four implementations of the same idea.
   

  

 This is a hands\-on seat. You will specify an architecture and prototype it yourself in the same week. A design that reads well and cannot be built is a failure, and so is a method that works in a notebook and falls over at ten thousand users. The domain moves with the product : retail and consumer goods in Compete, marketing in Incivus, research in Synthetic Audiences, and whatever Agent5i lands in next. Depth in method transfers, depth in a single industry does not, and we are hiring for the former. Your designs become constraints for the Full Stack Architect and the Cloud and Data Architect, so involving both early is expected rather than optional.
   

  

 Yes, that means reading Papers with Code, working out which of it holds, and turning the one paper in twenty that does into a feature the products can ship. That is Applied AI in this seat. Wiring up tool calls is not.
   

  

**How We Work**
 Flat. Three things decide whether you succeed here, and we weight them above any line on your CV.
   

  

* Proactivity : Nobody hands you a scoped problem. Find where a product is losing to its own method, size it, decide whether it is worth solving now, then design it. The same applies to research : much of what is published is not production\-ready, and saying so in week one rather than after three months of build is part of what this seat is for.
* Adaptability : The domain changes with the product and the methods change faster. Model providers change, agent frameworks are superseded, roadmaps move. Treat the churn as normal rather than as a planning failure.
* Accountability : You own the outcome from design to production, not the design. There is no handover at specification. You stay with it through build and evaluation, and if the estimate was wrong it was your estimate. Delegation to the engineering team is not available.


**What You Will Own**
* Method selection : whether prompting, retrieval, fine\-tuning, a domain\-specific small model or none of them is right for a given capability, across all four products.
* Core, shared or no : whether a capability belongs in one product, is worth building once for all four, or should not be built at all.
* Agentic system design : agent decomposition, tool and function contracts, orchestration, context assembly, guardrails and human\-in\-the\-loop points.
* Retrieval and domain model strategy : hybrid retrieval, chunking and reranking, and fine\-tuning or domain\-specific small models where they beat prompting on cost or accuracy.
* Evaluation strategy : success criteria agreed with product before build, including golden sets, acceptance thresholds and regression suites.
* Feasibility and estimation : what a roadmap item costs to build and what it costs to serve, established before it is committed.
* Prototypes and method assessment : fast calls on whether an approach is worth pursuing, and on which published research is production\-ready.
* Continuity through build, with the Full Stack Architect and the Cloud and Data Architect involved early rather than at specification handover.


**Must Have**
* 8\-12 years in applied machine learning with production ownership. Bachelors or masters in Computer Science, Engineering or a related field.
* Four or more AI products or platforms taken from design to production and scaled to a live user base between 1,000 and 100,000\.
* Shipped generative AI to production users with accountability for the outcome : retrieval\-augmented generation, agentic workflows, tool and function calling, structured output.
* Current working knowledge of agentic patterns, retrieval architectures, fine\-tuning approaches and model evaluation.
* Evaluation design : golden sets, acceptance thresholds, regression suites and human review loops.
* Able to reach working depth in an unfamiliar business domain fast enough to design for it.
* Has written code recently and can still do so.
* Judgement to decline a method that would work once and not generalise.


**Good To Have**
* Domain\-specific language model or retrieval system design.
* Cost modeling for inference at scale : token economics, unit cost per query, caching and routing strategy.
* Evaluation harnesses or benchmark suites built for other teams to reuse.
* Responsible AI governance and model risk practice.
* More than one product domain : consumer goods, retail, marketing, pharma or supply chain.
* Published work, patents or conference contribution.


**On The Experience Band**
 The band is deliberate. Above it we consistently meet people who have optimised for depth in a settled environment, or who have moved far enough from implementation that design has come to mean specification. Neither works here.

**About RightCrowd**
 RightCrowd (A portfolio company of Bloom Equity Partners, is a leader in Physical Identity and Access Management (PIAM) solutions, helping organizations worldwide secure their facilities and manage who has access to what, where, and when. We work with major global enterprises across energy, manufacturing, financial services, and other critical industries to implement sophisticated access control and security systems.
   

  

**The Opportunity**
 We're looking for a seasoned Solution Architect to join our project delivery team \- someone who thrives at the intersection of cutting\-edge technology and direct customer engagement. This isn't your typical behind\-the\-scenes technical role.
   

  

**What Makes This Role Unique:**
**You're the Technical Leader** 
 \- You'll own the technical relationship with customers from initial requirements through successful deployment. You're not just implementing solutions; you're architecting them to meet specific customer needs.
   

  

**Direct Customer Impact** 
 \- Work directly with enterprise clients' project teams, building relationships while solving complex integration challenges. You'll see your technical expertise translate into real business value for major organizations.
   

  

**Diverse Technical Challenges** 
 \- Every project is different. One day you're integrating with Lenel OnGuard access control systems, the next you're troubleshooting Active Directory authentication, or configuring cloud\-based deployments.
   

  

**Growth \& Learning** 
 \- PIAM is a specialized, growing field. You'll become an expert in an area that combines traditional IT skills with cutting\-edge security technology.
   

  

**What You'll Be Doing:**
* Solution Design \& Implementation \- Lead technical delivery of PIAM solutions for enterprise customers
* Customer Collaboration \- Work directly with client teams to gather requirements, manage expectations, and ensure successful outcomes
* Technical Problem Solving \- Troubleshoot complex integrations involving SQL Server, Active Directory, web services, and various access control platforms
* Project Leadership \- Manage technical scope, timelines, and deliverables while mentoring junior team members
* System Integration \- Configure and deploy solutions that integrate with existing enterprise infrastructure


**Ideal Candidate Profile:**
* Experienced Professional (10\+ years) who doesn't need hand\-holding on basic IT concepts
* Strong SQL skills and comfort with Microsoft technologies (Windows Server, Active Directory, IIS)
* Customer\-focused with excellent communication skills \- you can explain complex technical concepts to both IT teams and business stakeholders
* Integration experience with applications, databases, and enterprise systems

About the Company/Team


Oracle Customer Success Services brings a One Oracle approach to helping customers achieve successful business outcomes through a broad portfolio of services and solutions delivered by certified and experienced professionals.


The organization supports customers throughout their cloud journey by combining customer\-centric delivery, integrated support services, and close collaboration with Oracle Development. The team focuses on accelerating cloud adoption, reducing implementation risk, improving operational resilience, and enabling customers to realize value from Oracle technologies.


Within this organization, the cloud migration and engineering team supports large\-scale healthcare transformation programs by designing secure, scalable, automated, and repeatable solutions on Oracle Cloud Infrastructure.


  
**Key Responsibilities**
------------------------

* Design and implement automated solutions for OCI tenancy provisioning, customer onboarding, and environment standardization.
* Develop reusable Infrastructure\-as\-Code modules using Terraform and OCI Resource Manager to provision networking, compute, storage, databases, load balancers, Kubernetes services, and related OCI resources.
* Build, enhance, and maintain CI/CD pipelines for automated infrastructure and application deployments using OCI DevOps, Jenkins, GitHub, GitLab, or comparable platforms.
* Develop orchestration workflows that automate environment provisioning, application deployment, configuration management, migration execution, validation, cutover, and rollback activities.
* Implement configuration management solutions using Ansible to maintain consistency, security, and reliability across multiple cloud environments.

* Enable monitoring, logging, incident response, operational automation, and self\-healing capabilities using OCI observability and management services.
* Create reusable automation frameworks, templates, technical documentation, and operational runbooks while promoting automation standards and best practices across the program.

**Qualifications \& Skills**
----------------------------

#### **Education**

* Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Engineering, or a related discipline.

#### **Experience**

* At least 5 years of experience in cloud automation, DevOps, infrastructure engineering, platform engineering, or a related field.
* At least 3 years of hands\-on experience with Oracle Cloud Infrastructure or a comparable enterprise cloud platform.
* Demonstrated experience supporting large\-scale cloud migration, modernization, or transformation programs.

#### **Technical Skills**

* Strong hands\-on experience with OCI services, including IAM, Networking, Compute, Storage, Load Balancer, Resource Manager, and OCI DevOps.
* Advanced working knowledge of Terraform, including the design and maintenance of reusable Infrastructure\-as\-Code modules.
* Experience using OCI Resource Manager for infrastructure provisioning and automation.
* Proficiency in Python and Bash or Shell scripting for cloud automation and operational workflows.
* Hands\-on experience with Ansible for configuration management and environment standardization.
* Experience designing and maintaining CI/CD pipelines using Jenkins, GitHub, OCI DevOps, GitLab, or similar tools.
* Understanding of cloud security, governance, identity management, policy enforcement, and compliance automation.
* Experience supporting deployment validation, migration cutover, rollback, and post\-migration operational activities.

#### **Core Competencies**

* Strong automation\-first mindset with a focus on repeatability, scalability, and operational efficiency.
* Excellent troubleshooting, analytical, and problem\-solving skills.
* Ability to collaborate effectively with globally distributed engineering, development, operations, security, and customer teams.
* Strong written and verbal communication skills, including the ability to create clear technical documentation and runbooks.
* Experience working in Agile or Scrum delivery environments.
* Ability to manage multiple priorities in a fast\-paced, large\-scale migration program.

### **Good\-to\-Have Qualifications**

* Oracle Cloud Infrastructure Architect Professional certification.
* Oracle Cloud Infrastructure DevOps Professional certification.
* HashiCorp Terraform Associate certification.
* Experience with healthcare applications, healthcare platforms, or healthcare cloud migration programs.
* Knowledge of HIPAA, HITRUST, and other healthcare regulatory or compliance requirements.
* Experience supporting large\-scale enterprise cloud transformation initiatives.

------------------------------

Before applying, consider the following questions to assess your fit for the role:

beee3237.description:
**📌 Job Title:** 
**DELIVERY MANAGER** 




**📍 Location:** 
 India (Hyderabad)
 



**🕒 Type:** 
 Full time
 



**📂 Department:** 




**Job Summary:** 




**As a Delivery Manager, you make delivery reliable across a portfolio of game studios. You do not build the games. Each studio lead owns their team’s production and their committed dates. Your job is to validate and de\-risk those commitments before they go upward, and to own the cross\-studio seam no single studio can see: risks, dependencies, and blockers across teams.** 




**You lead through influence, not direct control. You support studio leads toward autonomy and scale your involvement to how established each one is. You go hands\-on where a lead is still growing and stay light\-touch where they run reliably on their own.** 




**The strongest sign of your success is a studio that no longer needs you. You also line\-manage a team of Delivery Coordinators who keep day\-to\-day coordination running.** 




  





**Key Responsibilities:** 



* **Validate \& De\-Risk Commitments:** 
 Stress\-test each studio lead’s delivery plan, estimates, and risks before they go upward. You challenge and de\-risk; you do not overwrite. Where a date stays in dispute, you escalate it cleanly rather than override.
* **Own the Cross\-Studio Seam:** 
 Coordinate and clarify dependencies, risks, and blockers across studios, always respecting each studio lead's ownership of their own team.
* **Support Studio Leads Toward Autonomy:** 
 Support studio leads as they grow, matched to each studio’s maturity. Work more closely with newer leads and ease off as a studio runs reliably on its own. Think of your role as scaffolding: temporary support that helps a studio stand on its own.
* **Lead \& Develop Coordinators:** 
 Line\-manage a team of Delivery Coordinators, set consistent coordination standards, and grow their careers. Arbitrate when a studio’s day\-to\-day urgency and your cross\-studio priorities collide, so your coordinators are never caught between two bosses.
* **Manage Risk \& Escalation:** 
 Decide which risks to absorb and which to escalate. Raise issues early, with clear framing and timing, so the business handles them before they reach senior leadership.
* **Be the Single Source of Delivery Truth:** 
 Act as the one trusted channel between your studios and the wider business. PMO, governance, and senior leadership read the delivery picture through you and the shared board, not by interrogating individual teams. Keep that picture accurate and current.



  





**What Success Looks Like (First 3 to 6 Months)** 



* You validate and de\-risk studio commitments before they go upward, so dates hold and disputes escalate cleanly when they arise.
* You reconcile cross\-studio dependencies and resourcing conflicts before they stall a team.
* Your coordinators operate to a consistent standard, and growing studio leads are visibly more autonomous than when you started.
* The Director of Delivery has one trusted source of delivery truth for your portfolio.



  





**Required Qualifications:** 




**MUST HAVE SKILLS AND EXPERIENCE** 



* **Experience:** 
 5\+ years as a Delivery Manager or delivery lead for cross\-functional teams of 5 to 50 people, ideally across multiple teams at once.
* **Delivery Craft:** 
 Strong command of the SDLC and Agile delivery: planning and execution, risk management, quality assurance, resource management, performance monitoring, and stakeholder management.
* **Influence Without Authority:** 
 A proven track record of securing reliable commitments from leaders you do not directly manage, and of holding a portfolio\-level view across competing teams.
* **People Leadership:** 
 Experience managing and developing coordinators, PMs, or similar. You set standards and grow people, not just track tasks.
* **Mindset:** 
 A startup mindset, comfortable with ambiguity and ready to build and scale a delivery function from the ground up.



  





**Preferred Qualifications (Nice\-to\-Have)** 



* Knowledge or hands\-on experience in the game development industry and its production process.
* Experience in the Gaming industry (highly desirable).
* Background with startups and/or IT companies.
* Technical literacy in one or more of Java, NodeJS, ReactJS, JavaScript, TypeScript, or Cocos.
* A data and metrics driven approach to monitoring delivery health.

d1625541.title: IT Data Architect
d1625541.description:
Requisition Number: 77523
   

  

**The company built on breakthroughs.
   

  

 Join us.**
 Corning is one of the world’s leading innovators in glass, ceramic, and materials science. From the depths of the ocean to the farthest reaches of space, our technologies push the boundaries of what’s possible.
   

  

 How do we do this? With our people. They break through limitations and expectations – not once in a career, but every day. They help move our company, and the world, forward.
   

  

 At Corning, there are endless possibilities for making an impact. You can help connect the unconnected, drive the future of automobiles, transform at\-home entertainment, and ensure the delivery of lifesaving medicines. And so much more.
   

  

 Come break through with us.
   

  

 The global Information Technology (IT) Function is leading efforts to align IT and Business Strategy, leverage IT investments, and optimize end to end business processes and associated information integration technologies. Through these efforts, IT helps to improve the competitive position of Corning's businesses through IT enabled processes. IT also delivers Information Technology applications, infrastructure, and project services in a cost efficient manner to Corning worldwide.
   

  

**Role Summary:** 
 The Data Architect is responsible for the design and evolution of our enterprise data architecture, with a strong focus on reusable data pipelines, data schemas \& products, and modern data engineering practices. This role requires an AI\-first mindset in data engineering and data modeling activities that enable the business to use data effectively and consistently across domains.
   

  

 You will partner closely with product owners, data engineers, data analysts, and business stakeholders to:
   

  

* Define and maintain enterprise data models and domain boundaries using traditional and AI\-enabled methods
* Design and govern reusable data assets and data products
* Establish standards and patterns for robust, scalable data pipelines
* Ensure data is discoverable, trustworthy, and fit\-for\-purpose for analytics, ML, and operational use cases


 The ideal candidate blends deep technical expertise with strong business acumen and can translate complex business needs into clear, implementable data designs. They will evaluate and recommend different solutions and provide leadership to the product and engineering teams in delivering architecture, design, and development of solutions across multiple data products.
   

  

**Essential Responsibilities**
**Domain Data Architecture**
* Define and evolve conceptual, logical, and physical data models across core business domains.
* Establish canonical and semantic models, shared dimensions, and reference data to enable consistent reporting and cross\-functional integration.
* Design reusable business entities, metrics, and data structures that support enterprise\-wide consistency and scalability.
* Partner with business stakeholders to translate processes, KPIs, and analytical needs into effective data models and semantic layers.
* Recommend fit\-for\-purpose modeling approaches based on business and technical requirements.


**Data Products and Reusable Design Patterns**
* Define standards for data products, including structure, naming, documentation, versioning, quality expectations, and lifecycle management.
* Develop reusable patterns for data ingestion, transformation, and consumption that can be scaled across teams and use cases.
* Partner with data engineering teams to create reference architectures, templates, and reusable implementation assets.
* Establish schema design and evolution practices that support ongoing change while minimizing downstream impact.
* Contribute to iterative solution delivery through Agile and DevOps practices.


**Data Pipeline and Platform Architecture**
* Design end\-to\-end data pipeline architectures for batch, near real time, and event\-driven use cases.
* Define logical and physical architecture patterns using cloud\-native platforms and modern data technologies.
* Guide the development of scalable, secure, reliable, and cost\-effective data solutions using tools such as Databricks, dbt, SQL, Python or Scala, and orchestration frameworks.
* Ensure solutions are built with strong observability, testing, performance, and operational reliability.
* Collaborate with engineering teams to support production\-ready implementation and continuous improvement.


**Governance, Standards, and Technical Leadership**
* Embed data governance, security, compliance, lineage, metadata, and retention requirements into architecture and design decisions.
* Define and promote standards for data quality, validation, cataloging, access controls, and engineering best practices.
* Provide technical leadership and mentoring to data engineers, analysts, and architects to drive consistent adoption of standards and patterns.
* Evaluate emerging technologies and architectural approaches and make recommendations aligned to business priorities.


**Qualifications/Requirements**
* 7–10 years of relevant IT experience, with at least 4\+ years in a Data Architect, Senior Data Engineer, or similar role focused on data design and modeling.
* 5\+ years of experience designing and implementing data models for analytics and operational reporting (dimensional, normalized, and/or domain\-driven designs).
* 5\+ years of experience building and/or guiding the development of ETL/ELT pipelines in cloud or modern data platforms.
* 4\+ years of hands\-on experience with Databricks or similar cloud\-based lakehouse platforms supporting enterprise data lakes, data warehouses, and business intelligence
* 2\+ years of experience using dbt (or similar transformation frameworks) including model structuring, tests, and documentation.
* Strong proficiency in SQL and experience with at least one programming language used in data engineering (Python or Scala preferred).
* Experience using Git and related DevOps tooling (GitHub/GitLab/Bitbucket, CI/CD pipelines such as GitHub Actions, Azure DevOps, Jenkins, etc.).
* Experience with data catalog/lineage/metadata tools is a plus (e.g., Collibra, Alation, Unity Catalog, Purview).
* Familiarity with modern data architecture paradigms such as data mesh and domain\-oriented architecture


**Desired Qualifications**
 The successful candidate for this position will have the following general experience and expertise:
   

  

* Ability to navigate ambiguity, make decisions with incomplete information, and drive consensus.
* Strong problem\-solving skills with a structured, analytical approach.
* Highly self\-motivated, organized, and able to manage multiple priorities.
* Experience working with distributed and/or international teams is a plus.
* Strong communication and presentation skills, with the ability to engage technical and non\-technical audiences effectively


**Travel** 
 : Limited work travel

8a000fed.description:
← Back to all jobs
   

  

 Senior Program Manager in Bengaluru \| Mentor Together
   

  

 Mentor Together
   

  

 full\-time📍 Bengaluru, Karnatakasenior levelCompetitive
   

  

 Mentor Together
   

  

 Mentor Together is an award\-winning non\-profit that started the youth mentoring movement in India. Over 15 years it has turned mentoring from informal, loosely defined guidance into a safe, structured, evidence\-based way to help children and young people facing hardship move through education, careers and life changes. Its own digital mentoring platform, Mentor To Go, connects a national network of colleges, government departments and corporate partners. The work meets over 95% of the globally recognised Elements of Effective Practice for Mentoring, and covers direct digital mentoring, government systems, curriculum and research. This role sits within Mentor Together's program operations team, which plans and runs the mentoring cycles that reach young people on the ground.
   

  

 Role
   

  

 The Senior Program Manager leads the planning and running of a mentoring programme that helps young women from low\-income backgrounds move from college into work. The programme runs across Karnataka, Maharashtra and Telangana on the Mentor To Go platform, with a Foundation tier for pre\-final year students and a Placement tier that takes final\-year students through to certified placement readiness. You are the main point of accountability for delivery quality, outcomes, donor reporting and the team.
   

  

**Responsibilities**
* Own program\-level operational planning across the Foundation and Placement mentoring tiers, including annual, quarterly and monthly plans.
* Translate programme goals into structured operations across outreach, onboarding, self\-learning, screening, matching, mentoring delivery and closure.
* Oversee mentee mobilisation through college town halls, screening workshops, income verification and interviews.
* Maintain the Mentor To Go quality standard across roughly 800 to 900 mentees, including orientations, check\-ins, relationship\-quality surveys and structured closure.
* Lead mobilisation, screening, verification, safeguarding checks and training of volunteer corporate mentors.
* Serve as primary relationship owner for the corporate partner, coordinating mentor pipelines and donor reporting end\-to\-end.
* Direct placement\-support for final\-year cohorts, including employer mapping, opportunity discovery and placement\-readiness certification.
* Guide responsible use of AI\-enabled tools for job search.
* Lead and manage the program operations team of about 6 members, including goal\-setting, coaching and feedback.
* Lead internal and external programme reporting, ensuring data integrity and timely review of dashboards and trackers.
* Anticipate delivery risks such as onboarding delays or mentor and mentee drop\-off, and implement mitigations.
* Uphold financial discipline in expense review and approval, and ensure safeguarding rigour throughout the programme.


**Requirements**
* 8 to 10 years of professional experience, with substantial program management or leadership exposure.
* Demonstrated experience with youth\-focused programmes in employability, skilling or education\-linked contexts.
* Experience with gender\-focused programming and/or placement and employer engagement is a strong advantage.
* Proven ability to manage corporate or donor partnerships, including volunteer mobilisation and donor reporting.
* Strong analytical, planning and problem\-solving abilities, with high comfort using Excel, tracking systems, project\-planning tools and dashboards.
* Exceptional attention to detail and execution discipline.
* Strong oral and written communication skills.
* Sound judgment, an ownership mindset, sensitivity to safeguarding and operational reliability in fast\-paced environments.


**Benefits**
* Lead a distinctive gender\-focused programme with clear transition\-to\-work outcomes.
* Manage a team of six and own a corporate partnership end to end.
* Work with an organisation whose practice meets over 95% of the global Elements of Effective Practice for Mentoring.
* Join a workplace built on youth\-centric, impact\-driven values that put growth, curiosity and ownership first.

**Job Title:** MRO Functional Consultant (SAP EAM / iMRO)
  
Role Summary
  
We are looking for an experienced MRO Functional Consultant with strong expertise in SAP EAM / iMRO to support maintenance operations and engineering processes. The role will focus on designing, configuring, and optimizing SAP\-based maintenance solutions, ensuring alignment with business requirements across maintenance execution, planning, and engineering functions.

* Enable efficient execution of maintenance operations including work order lifecycle and material consumption

* Experience in implementing maintenance operations and maintenance engineering processes in iMRO
* Experience in S/4HANA preferred
* Deep understanding of:
* Maintenance order lifecycle and planning strategies
* Integration with MM (inventory, reservations, procurement)

5655c007.title: Pre-Sales Engineer – Biometric And Access Control
5655c007.description:
**Pre\-Sales Engineer Biometric \& Access Control** 




**Location: Sola, Ahmedabad** 




**Experience: 1\-3 Years** 




**Employment Type: Full\-time** 




**Department: Sales / Pre\-Sales** 




  





**About the Role** 




  





 We are looking for a Pre\-Sales Engineer who is technically skilled, customer\-focused, and passionate about biometric technology and security solutions.
 



  





 As a Pre\-Sales Engineer, you will act as the technical bridge between our sales team and customers, understanding business and technical requirements and translating them into the right biometric identification, attendance, and access control solutions.
 



  





 You will work with customers across industries including corporates, manufacturing, government, healthcare, education, and other enterprise environments. The role involves solution design, product demonstrations, technical proposals, Proof of Concepts (POCs), system integration discussions, and technical support throughout the sales cycle.
 



  





**Key Responsibilities** 




 1\.
 **Technical Pre\-Sales Support** 




 Work closely with the sales team to understand customer requirements and recommend appropriate technical solutions.
 



 Participate in client meetings, technical discussions, presentations, and solution workshops.
 



 Conduct product demonstrations and live testing of biometric devices and solutions.
 



 Provide technical consultation and support throughout the sales cycle.
 



 Understand customer infrastructure and identify the most suitable solution architecture.
 



 2\.
 **Solution Design \& Architecture** 




 Analyze customer infrastructure, business requirements, and security needs.
 



 Design biometric attendance and access control solutions based on customer requirements.
 



 Prepare system architecture diagrams covering devices, networking, software, and integrations.
 



 Recommend appropriate biometric hardware, software, configurations, and deployment models.
 



 Evaluate technical feasibility and identify potential implementation challenges.
 



 3\.
 **Technical Proposals \& Documentation** 




 Prepare technical proposals, solution documents, and Bill of Materials (BOM).
 



 Assist with RFP/RFQ responses, tenders, and technical submissions.
 



 Prepare product comparison sheets, technical presentations, solution briefs, and other sales\-support documentation.
 



 Clearly document proposed solutions, specifications, integrations, and implementation requirements.
 



 4\.
 **Proof of Concept (POC) \& Product Demonstrations** 




 Configure and deploy biometric devices for customer demonstrations and trials.
 



 Plan and execute Proof of Concept (POC) deployments.
 



 Validate solution functionality against customer requirements.
 



 Troubleshoot technical issues during demonstrations, trials, and POCs.
 



 Capture customer feedback and coordinate internally for required improvements.
 



 5\.
 **Integration \& Technical Coordination** 




 Support integration discussions and implementation of biometric solutions with:
 



 HRMS platforms
 



 Payroll software
 



 ERP systems
 



 Access control platforms
 



 Other third\-party applications
 



 Understand API\-based integration requirements and coordinate with technical teams.
 



 Work closely with product, development, implementation, and support teams to ensure successful solution deployment.
 



 Assist in resolving technical queries raised by customers and partners.
 



 6\.
 **Client \& Internal Training** 




 Conduct technical training for customers, channel partners, and internal sales teams.
 



 Guide users on device configuration, software functionality, and system management.
 



 Provide technical clarifications before and after product demonstrations.
 



 Create or contribute to technical training and knowledge\-sharing material.
 



  





**Technical Skills Required** 




 Good understanding of biometric technologies, including:
 



 Fingerprint recognition
 



 Facial recognition
 



 Iris recognition
 



 Understanding of biometric attendance and access control systems.
 



 Basic knowledge of computer networking:
 



 TCP/IP
 



 LAN/WAN
 



 IP configuration
 



 Network troubleshooting
 



 Familiarity with API integrations and software platforms.
 



 Experience with device configuration, testing, commissioning, and troubleshooting.
 



 Basic understanding of databases such as SQL/MySQL will be an advantage.
 



 Ability to understand technical architecture and translate customer requirements into practical solutions.
 



  





**Soft Skills** 




 Excellent communication and presentation skills.
 



 Ability to explain complex technical concepts in simple, customer\-friendly language.
 



 Strong problem\-solving and analytical abilities.
 



 Customer\-focused and consultative approach.
 



 Good documentation and reporting skills.
 



 Ability to collaborate effectively with sales, product, development, implementation, and support teams.
 



 Comfortable conducting presentations and technical discussions with customers.
 



 Willingness to travel for customer meetings, demonstrations, and POCs when required.
 



  





**Key Performance Indicators (KPIs)** 




 Success in this role will be measured through:
 



 Quality and successful completion of technical product demonstrations.
 



 Number and quality of technical solutions designed for customer opportunities.
 



 Contribution to sales conversion through effective technical support.
 



 Successful execution and deployment of POCs.
 



 Customer satisfaction with technical consultation and demonstrations.
 



 Accuracy and quality of technical proposals, BOMs, and solution documentation.
 



 Effective coordination with internal technical and sales teams.
 



  





**What We're Looking For** 




 The ideal candidate is someone who combines technical knowledge with strong customer\-facing skills. You should be comfortable moving between a technical discussion with an IT/networking team and a business\-oriented conversation with a customer or sales team.
 



 If you enjoy technology, solution design, customer interaction, troubleshooting, and helping sales teams win complex technical opportunities, this role could be a great fit.

 Technical Architecture \& Ownership

 AWS Architecture

 Custom Edge Solutions

 Observability \& Dashboards

* Resolve technical escalations and remove technical blockers.
* Ensure quality at each project phase gate.

 Migration Runbooks

**Company Profile**

Infocusp Innovations is an IT firm working in the broad fields of Machine Learning, Artificial Intelligence (AI), Computer Science, Software Engineering, Mobile and Web App Development, QA, and Signal Processing. Global presence in India and The United States of America with offices in Ahmedabad, Pune and California, we make businesses smart and systems smarter to make people's lives easier. Our teams work closely with the research and product engineering teams to develop next\-gen robust solutions that improve the quality of life of users and enhance the user experience. We have worked on high\-impact projects in the domains of Healthcare, FinTech, IoT, Law and Humanity, AgroTech and Horticulture, Molecular Chemistry, GeoPhysics, Biology, Energy, Logistics, Recruitment and Gaming.

Transparent communication, healthy and constructive discussions along with an open and welcoming work culture are what we prefer at Infocusp. We make conscious decisions to facilitate our work with favorable working conditions and amenities that enable our employees to give their best.

**About the Role**

We are looking for a highly skilled **Senior Backend Engineer** to design, develop, and scale robust backend platforms and applications. The ideal candidate will have strong expertise in backend engineering, distributed systems, and cloud\-native architectures. This role requires hands\-on experience in building scalable services, optimizing cloud infrastructure, and ensuring reliability, observability, and security in production environments.

**Responsibilities**

1\. **Backend Engineering \& Platform Development**

* Design, develop, and maintain scalable backend services using **Python**, **FastAPI**, and asynchronous microservices architectures.
* Build and optimize data\-intensive applications using **PostgreSQL**, **Redis**, **MongoDB** or equivalent technologies at production scale.
* Develop high\-performance APIs and distributed systems to support AI\-driven applications.

**2\. Cloud Infrastructure \& DevOps**

* Architect and manage cloud\-native applications on **AWS** or **GCP**.
* Deploy and operate services using **ECS, EKS, Lambda, Cloud Run**, **GCP \- GKE,** and other cloud\-native technologies.
* Implement and manage Infrastructure as Code (IaC) using **Terraform or equivalent frameworks like Pulumi or CloudFormation.**
* Build and optimize CI/CD pipelines for reliable and automated deployments.
* Experience with **Apache Kafka** for building event\-driven, scalable, and distributed systems.
* Manage and troubleshoot **containerized applications using Docker and Kubernetes**, ensuring scalability, availability, and performance.

**3\. Monitoring and Observability** 

* Instrument backend services end\-to\-end with metrics, distributed tracing, and structured logging using OpenTelemetry
* Hands\-on with some observability stacks — Prometheus \+ Grafana, Datadog/New Relic, and centralized logging (ELK/Loki)
* Build actionable dashboards and alerting to detect latency, errors, and resource bottlenecks before customer impact

**Requirements**

* 4\+ years of experience in backend development.

* Strong experience in **Python development** and **FastAPI**.
* Hands\-on experience with **asynchronous microservices architectures**.

* Experience with **AWS or GCP cloud platforms** and Infrastructure as Code (**Terraform**, CloudFormation, or equivalent).

* Build and deploy AI/ML models for telecom use cases such as churn prediction, anomaly detection, capacity forecasting, optimisation, and predictive maintenance.
* Architect enterprise data lakes, warehouses, and analytics platforms for batch and real‑time processing.
* Optimise ETL/ELT frameworks with focus on data quality, governance, lineage, and scalability.



  





**Solutioning \& Delivery Leadership** 



* Lead solution design and presales activities including proposals, architecture presentations, effort estimation, and costing.
* Deliver large telecom transformation programs covering design, development, testing, migration, deployment, and rollout.
* Define migration, cutover, and rollback strategies to ensure seamless implementation and business continuity.
* Support post‑production operations by monitoring performance, ensuring SLA adherence, and driving continuous improvements.



  





**Team Leadership \& Best Practices** 



* Mentor technical teams and establish reusable frameworks, accelerators, and methodologies.
* Drive adoption of best practices across telecom analytics and data engineering initiatives.



  





**We'd Love to Hear From You If...** 




  





**Experience** 



* You have 9–14 years of experience in Telecom, Network Services, Data Engineering, Analytics, or AI/ML domains.
* You have strong understanding of telecom network architecture (RAN, Core, BSC/BTS, OSS/BSS, packet and circuit‑switched).
* You have worked with telecom data sources (CDRs, xDRs, PM/FM data, alarms, telemetry, inventory, topology).
* You have led architecture discussions, customer workshops, solutioning, and presales engagements.



  





**Technical Expertise** 



* You have hands‑on experience in data engineering, pipeline development, data lakes, warehouses, and real‑time analytics.
* You are skilled in ETL/ELT frameworks, data governance, and cloud/big data ecosystems.
* You have knowledge of AI/ML model development and deployment for telecom use cases.



  





**Ways of Working** 



* You demonstrate strong stakeholder management, communication, and leadership skills.
* You thrive in customer‑facing consulting and presales engagements.
* You are proactive in bridging telecom expertise with advanced analytics to enable intelligent operations.



  





**Preferred Qualifications** 



* Experience in autonomous networks, network automation, and AI‑driven telecom operations.
* Exposure to cloud platforms and modern data technologies.
* Experience with global telecom operators and CSP customers.



  





 \-\-\-

 Thakral One is a consulting and technology services company headquartered in Singapore, with a pan\-Asian presence.
