* Experience driving the entire sales cycle (e.g., defining the delivery and consumption plan and transitioning it for execution).
* Experience building long\-term technical strategies to uncover new workloads with customers.
* Experience migrating applications and services to cloud platforms.
* Experience working with AI, building Agentic systems and AI based solutions.


**About the job** 
 The Google Cloud Platform team helps customers transform and build what's next for their business — all with technology built in the cloud. Our products are developed for security, reliability and scalability, running the full stack from infrastructure to applications to devices and hardware. Our teams are dedicated to helping our customers — developers, small and large businesses, educational institutions and government agencies — see the benefits of our technology come to life. As part of an entrepreneurial team in this rapidly growing business, you will play a key role in understanding the needs of our customers and help shape the future of businesses of all sizes use technology to connect with customers, employees and partners.
   

  

 As a Platform Customer Engineer, you will partner with technical Sales teams to differentiate Google Cloud to our customers. You will serve as the customer’s primary technical partner and trusted advisor, engaging in technical\-led conversations to understand their business challenges. You will troubleshoot technical questions and roadblocks, engage in proofs of concepts and demos, and use your expertise to architect cross\-pillar cloud solutions that solve these business challenges. You will drive the technical win and define the delivery and consumption plans. You will use your strategic acumen and presentation skills to engage with technical and business leaders, and persuasively present practical and useful solutions on Google Cloud. You will have a breadth of technical expertise, spanning infrastructure modernization, application modernization, data analytics and more. You will blend sales expertise, market knowledge and direct technical engagement to prove the value of the Google Cloud portfolio.Google Cloud accelerates every organization’s ability to digitally transform its business and industry. We deliver enterprise\-grade solutions that leverage Google’s cutting\-edge technology, and tools that help developers build more sustainably. Customers in more than 200 countries and territories turn to Google Cloud as their trusted partner to enable growth and solve their most critical business problems.
   

  

**Responsibilities**
* Develop and own the technical account plan and strategy, participating in planning and supporting targeted sales motions.
* Combine sales, programming, and solutions architecture expertise to prove the value of Google Cloud Platform across the portfolio through complex demos, pilots and in\-depth workshops.
* Architect cross\-pillar solutions, drive technical wins, and define initial delivery plans for customers; continue to lead the technical engagement in the solution phase.
* Facilitate the post\-sales transition by supporting pricing activities and transitioning the final delivery plan to implementation teams.
* Maintain awareness of progress against the delivery plan, providing support to cross\-functional teams during ramp, delivery, migration or implementation phases.


 Google is proud to be an equal opportunity workplace and is an affirmative action employer. We are committed to equal employment opportunity regardless of race, color, ancestry, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, age, citizenship, marital status, disability, gender identity or Veteran status. We also consider qualified applicants regardless of criminal histories, consistent with legal requirements. See also Google's EEO Policy and EEO is the Law. If you have a disability or special need that requires accommodation, please let us know by completing our Accommodations for Applicants form .

* Champion and communicate new features, updates, and report releases, ensuring stakeholders understand and take advantage of new capability.

 What Skills and Knowledge Will You Bring?

 Why SentinelOne?
   

  

 AI is redefining how the world operates and rewriting the rules of security in real time, and SentinelOne was built for this moment. 5d7c17cf.title: Senior Managed Services Consultant
5d7c17cf.description:
Sprinklr is the definitive, AI\-native platform for Unified Customer Experience Management (Unified\-CXM), empowering brands to deliver extraordinary experiences at scale — across every customer touchpoint.


By combining human instinct with the speed and efficiency of AI, Sprinklr helps brands earn trust and loyalty through personalized, seamless, and efficient customer interactions. Sprinklr’s unified platform provides powerful solutions for every customer\-facing team — spanning social media management, marketing, advertising, customer feedback, and omnichannel contact center management — enabling enterprises to unify data, break down silos, and act on real\-time insights.


Today, 1,900\+ enterprises and 60% of the Fortune 100 rely on Sprinklr to help them deliver consistent, trusted customer experiences worldwide.

**Job Description**
-------------------

**Role Summary**  

  

Support managed services delivery for Sprinklr Community customers by configuring, optimizing, and maintaining brand communities, discussion forums, and digital engagement experiences. Focus on operational excellence, platform governance, customer support, community growth, and continuous platform adoption.  

  

**What You’ll Do**

* Manage day\-to\-day support and administration of Sprinklr Community platforms, ensuring operational stability and adherence to SLAs.
* Configure and maintain community structures including forums, discussion boards, categories, topics, user groups, gamification, moderation workflows, and permissions.
* Execute platform enhancements, configuration changes, and optimization initiatives aligned to customer requirements and best practices.
* Support community moderation processes, including content triaging, escalation management, agent assignment, and user governance.
* Troubleshoot platform, user access, workflow, content visibility, notification, and engagement\-related issues.
* Monitor community health, user engagement, adoption metrics, and operational performance, recommending improvement opportunities.
* Support branding, page configurations, templates, widgets, navigation, and UI/UX enhancements using HTML, CSS, and JavaScript.
* Assist with API\-based integrations and data exchanges with third\-party platforms, CRM systems, SSO providers, and digital ecosystems.
* Collaborate with customer stakeholders to gather requirements, recommend best practices, and deliver configuration\-led solutions.
* Provide post\-go\-live support, enhancement management, platform governance, and release validation activities.
* Develop and maintain operational documentation, knowledge articles, runbooks, and community administration guides.
* Support user onboarding, training, and adoption programs to maximize platform utilization and business value.

  

  

**What Makes You Qualified?**  

  

**Must Have Qualifications**

* 5\-8 years of experience in Managed Services, SaaS Platform Support, Community Management, or Digital Experience platforms.
* Hands\-on experience with Sprinklr Community or similar platforms such as Khoros, Gainsight, Salesforce Experience Cloud, Zendesk Communities, or Higher Logic.
* Experience configuring workflows, user roles, permissions, moderation processes, community structures, and governance controls.
* Working knowledge of HTML, CSS, JavaScript, and web content management concepts.
* Understanding of REST APIs, JSON, authentication mechanisms, and integration troubleshooting.
* Strong analytical, troubleshooting, incident management, and stakeholder communication skills.
* Experience working in customer\-facing environments with ownership of service delivery and operational outcomes.

**Good to Have Skills**

* Experience managing brand communities, customer support forums, knowledge communities, or advocacy programs.
* Familiarity with SSO, OAuth, webhooks, and CRM integrations.
* Knowledge of SEO, accessibility, and community engagement best practices.
* Experience with ticketing and project management tools such as Jira, Azure DevOps, or ServiceNow.
* Exposure to digital customer experience, customer success, or online community operations.

 **Who You Are**

* Customer\-focused with a strong managed services mindset.
* Detail\-oriented and proactive in identifying operational improvements.
* Comfortable balancing technical troubleshooting with business stakeholder engagement.
* A collaborative consultant who takes ownership of customer outcomes and platform success.

 **What Success Looks Like**

* Stable and optimized community operations.
* High SLA adherence and timely issue resolution.
* Increased platform adoption and community engagement.
* Well\-governed, scalable, and user\-friendly community experiences.
* Strong customer satisfaction and stakeholder confidence.
**We focus on our mission**: Sprinklr was founded in 2009 to solve a big problem: growing enterprise complexity that separated brands from their customers. Our vision was clear: to unify fragmented teams, tools and data — helping large organizations build deeper, more meaningful connections with the people they serve. Today, Sprinklr has a unified, AI\-native platform for four product suites: Sprinklr Service, Sprinklr Social, Sprinklr Marketing, and Sprinklr Insights. Sprinklr is here to do three things:

* Lead a new category of enterprise software that we call Unified\-CXM.
* Empower companies to deliver next generation, unified engagement journeys that reimagine the customer experience.
* Create a culture of customer obsession, with trust, teamwork, and accountability.

**We believe in our product**: Customers who value exceptional customer experiences have what they need on our single unified platform, built with an operating system approach on a single codebase. That means that everything — and everyone — can work together to service, respond, sell, and market to customers on the channels they prefer. While Unified Customer Experience Management (Unified\-CXM) as a category is just getting started, we are well on our way to creating a no\-compromise, unified approach to better customer experiences for the world’s leading enterprise brands.

 **We invest in our people**: We offer a comprehensive suite of benefits designed to help each member of our team thrive. Sprinklr believes that you should be able to get the type of care you need for your personal well\-being when you need it. We offer you and your family voluntary healthcare coverage in countries where applicable. We believe it is important to take time off – it is essential for your mental and physical wellbeing. We provide Sprinklrites with paid time off to recharge and spend time with loved ones. We want to grow our talent with purpose. Our open Mentoring Program is designed to create meaningful connections that support growth and amplify our focus.


To learn more about employee benefits by region, click here.


To learn more about all\-things\-Sprinklr, visit our candidate resource hub here.

**EEO \- Our philosophy**: Our goal is to ensure every employee feels like they belong and are operating in a collaborative environment. We fervently believe every employee matters and should be respected and heard. We believe we are stronger when we belong because collectively, we’re more innovative, creative, and successful.


Sprinklr is proud to be an equal\-opportunity workplace and complies with all applicable federal, state, and local fair employment practices laws. We are committed to equal employment opportunity regardless of race, color, religion, creed, national origin or ancestry, ethnicity, sex (including gender, pregnancy, sexual orientation, and gender identity), age, physical or mental disability, citizenship, past, current, or prospective service in the uniformed services, genetic information, or any other characteristic protected under applicable law.

  

Reasonable accommodations are available upon request during the interview process. To request an accommodation, please work directly with your recruitment coordinator or recruiter.

**Warning about Recruiting Scams:** Please be vigilant for recruiting scams impersonating Sprinklr. Sprinklr will never ask you for money, to pay for equipment, or for unnecessary personal information during the interview process. Sprinklr will also never pay in Bitcoin or send email communications from our executives. Please review the Federal Trade Commission's advice to avoid these types of scams.


If you are contacted by someone whom you suspect may not be appropriately representing Sprinklr, please do not engage and block their email or phone number immediately.

**Role**

**Key Responsibilities**

* Develop and maintain **architectural Revit models** from concept through technical design stages.
* Prepare **plans, sections, elevations, schedules, details and drawing sheets** to UK documentation standards.

* Support **clash detection, model reviews, issue tracking and coordination** using Navisworks / ACC.
* Review UK architect markups and update **models and drawings** accurately.
* Support project deliverables across **RIBA stages**, including concept, planning, developed design, tender and technical design.

* Good knowledge of **architectural BIM modelling and technical drawing production**.
* Experience with **Navisworks Manage** for model coordination and clash review.
* Understanding of **ISO 19650, BIM workflows, naming conventions, LOD/LOI and model standards**.
* Ability to create and manage **Revit families, schedules, templates, views, sheets and linked models**.
* Knowledge of **UK Building Regulations, RIBA stages and UK architectural drawing standards**.

* **Gulf project experience** is preferred.
* Experience in **residential, commercial, healthcare, education or industrial projects** is beneficial.

* A **Revit\-based portfolio** of architectural models and drawings is preferred.

We are looking for BIM Architects who can **work independently, maintain high\-quality Revit models, coordinate effectively with multidisciplinary teams and deliver accurate architectural drawings and BIM packages** for UK projects.

ffbc5143.title: Regional Program Manager; Project Management
ffbc5143.description:
**Regional Program Manager – Project Management**

**Position Summary**

**Flowserve** is seeking an experienced Regional Program Manager – Project Management to oversee project\-management execution, performance improvement, and capability development across regional manufacturing sites.


The role is responsible for high\-value, complex, engineered\-to\-order customer projects for flow\-control equipment. Working with factory project managers, site leadership, and cross\-functional teams, the Regional Program Manager will improve delivery performance, profitability, risk management, customer experience, and compliance with contractual obligations.


The position reports to the Global Director of Project Management and operates through strong matrix leadership, stakeholder influence, and direct intervention in critical project situations.

**Key Responsibilities**

* Oversee the regional portfolio of complex customer projects from initiation through delivery, customer acceptance, and closeout.
* Monitor and report project health, safety, schedule, profitability, revenue, gross margin, percentage of completion, cash flow, customer experience, project risks, and key milestones.
* Support factory project managers with project planning, manufacturing coordination, documentation, customer requirements, and timely delivery against contractual obligations.
* Identify performance gaps, recommend corrective actions, and support implementation of improvement plans to strengthen project performance.
* Drive alignment with Flowserve global project\-management policies, procedures, work processes, reporting standards, and maturity expectations.
* Support contract reviews, change management, risk registers, risk\-mitigation plans, and escalation of commercial, technical, or execution risks.
* Support strategic customer engagements, project escalations, and site\-level issue resolution when local capability or remote support is insufficient.
* Coordinate cross\-functional resources and subject\-matter experts to resolve complex project challenges.
* Coach and train project managers on contractual conditions, technical specifications, risk management, lessons learned, closeout practices, and standardized execution processes.
* Promote continuous improvement through lessons learned, standardized processes, lean and flow practices, and scalable solutions across multiple manufacturing locations.
* Present portfolio performance, project progress, risks, and recommended actions to senior and executive management.
* Travel to manufacturing sites and customer locations as needed for reviews, training, cross\-functional issue resolution, and customer support**.**

**Required Qualifications**

* Bachelor’s degree in Engineering, Business, or a related field.
* At least 10 years of relevant experience in valves, actuators, related industrial equipment, manufacturing, EPC, project management, or department\-management roles.
* At least 5 years of progressive experience leading international capital\-equipment procurement projects involving engineered\-to\-order equipment.
* Knowledge of capital\-project execution, EPC projects, or engineered\-to\-order manufacturing environments.
* Experience leading through influence in a matrix organization and working effectively with stakeholders outside direct reporting relationships.
* Familiarity with industrial standards including API, ISO, MSS, ASTM, and DIN.

e1af9f81.title: Program Manager II, FIAT - FPR team
e1af9f81.description:
**DESCRIPTION**
---------------


Have you ever thought about what it takes to detect and prevent fraud among hundreds of millions of e\-Commerce transactions in different countries? What would you do to create a trusted marketplace where millions of buyers and sellers can safely transact online? What kinds of processes and systems would you build to maximize customer satisfaction? Amazon is seeking a Workforce Manager who will be responsible for driving service levels, developing strategies for service expansions and optimizing resource utilization/occupancy through innovative ideas.  

  

Our overall mission is simple: We want Amazon to be the place where our customers can find, discover and buy anything online. Whatever our customers want, we will find the means to deliver it. With your help, Amazon will continue to enable people to discover new worlds. This is your chance to make history.  

We believe passionately that employing a diverse workforce is central to our success. We make recruiting decisions based on your experience and skills. We value your passion to discover, invent, simplify and build trust of our customers and sellers. Amazon hires the brightest minds, are you one of them?  

  

At Amazon, we're working to be the most customer\-centric company on earth. To get there, we need exceptionally talented, bright and intelligence driven people. The ideal candidate is expected to operate with significant autonomy and discretion, influences internal \& external teams. He/She will possess advanced analytical experience and basic knowledge of workforce management metrics. The individual must be capable to support and own proactive tactical \& strategic data analysis driven projects to address customer facing challenges and enable program management and decision making initiatives across SEPO. In this role you will experience a wide range of challenges and we expect you to approach the problems with swift data driven solutions.
  

  

Key job responsibilities  

Apply WFM knowledge and skills across HC planning, Scheduling and Real Time management.  

Manage a high performing team and deliver results along with performance management and team development.  

Create, maintain and disseminate project information to stakeholders and senior management, including confidential and privileged information through advanced data analysis and statistical controls  

Be a visible and vocal role model across the wider business for Amazon’s customer\-centric culture, championing Seller’s needs and using data and technology to anticipate and exceed them.  

Interact with stakeholders at multiple levels and dynamically lead difficult discussions by identifying and analyzing data to isolate issues, develop solutions and prioritize opportunities to improve experience of our customers  

Determine and implement effective program solutions quickly, so as to not impede BAU production, yet run projects/programs in a bubble/pilot environments  

Plan and manage multiple parallel data analysis and develop the next generation of automation tools for monitoring and measuring data quality, with associated user interfaces  

Contribute towards evolving the technical direction of SEPO analytical systems and play a critical role in the design and development of key programs run by WFM  



**BASIC QUALIFICATIONS**
------------------------

* 3\+ years of program or project management experience
* 3\+ years of working cross functionally with tech and non\-tech teams experience
* 3\+ years of defining and implementing process improvement initiatives using data and metrics experience
* Knowledge of Excel (Pivot Tables, VLookUps) at an advanced level and SQL
* Experience defining program requirements and using data and metrics to determine improvements

**PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS**
----------------------------

* 3\+ years of driving end to end delivery, and communicating results to senior leadership experience
* 3\+ years of driving process improvements experience
* Experience in stakeholder management, dealing with multiple stakeholders at varied levels of the organization
* Experience building processes, project management, and schedules

  

Our inclusive culture empowers Amazonians to deliver the best results for our customers. If you have a disability and need a workplace accommodation or adjustment during the application and hiring process, including support for the interview or onboarding process, please visit https://amazon.jobs/content/en/how\-we\-hire/accommodations for more information. If the country/region you’re applying in isn’t listed, please contact your Recruiting Partner.

667f2484.title: Senior Network Solution Designer
667f2484.description:
As a Senior Network Solution Designer to join the Access Networks organization. The candidate will be responsible for designing, implementing, and supporting complex enterprise and service‑provider‑grade network infrastructures. The role requires deep technical expertise in routing, switching, network segmentation, L2/L3 services, wireless infrastructure, and architectural design. The candidate must operate effectively both independently and within distributed global teams.


  
* Develop detailed High\-Level and Low\-Level Designs (HLD/LLD) for routing, switching, segmentation, Wi‑Fi, and NAC\-enabled environments
* Design scalable enterprise and service provider network architecture
* Evaluate architecture changes, define resiliency requirements, and ensure alignment to Nokia standards.
* Analyze and resolve complex production network issues while ensuring reliable service operation for both Wired and Wireless network services.
* Administer service requests, execute network changes, and manage escalated incidents or priority incidents end\-to\-end.
* Collaborate with cross\-technology teams to provide timely updates and coordinate incident resolutions.
* Identify root causes of network incidents and develop preventive actions while adhering to change management processes.
* Design and deploy wireless networks and authentication solutions, ensuring compliance with security best practices.
* Act as a L3 escalation point for L2 team members and mentor junior team members while staying updated on industry trends in network security technologies.
* Drive results and foster a strong customer focus in a dynamic, global team environment to maintain SLA compliance.

  
**You\-Have:**

* Bachelor's degree in Telecommunications, Information Technology, Computer Science, or equivalent with
  

12\+ years of experience in network services within complex environments
* Deep knowledge in Network Routing, Switching, design/configuration in Local Area Networks.
* Proficiency in authentication protocols like RADIUS, TACACS, and LDAP
* Proficiency in OSPF, ISIS, BGP, VRRP and MPLS network protocols,VPLS, VPRN and VLL services
* Familiarity with ITIL processes and network technologies and Engineer network resilience, redundancy and optimized traffic flows.

**Nice\-To\-Have**

* Knowledge of scripting and automation tools for network management
* Experience in configuration and management of Clearpass \& NAC
* WLAN knowledge specifically with Aruba Access Points and Controllers
* SROS Nokia Service Router Experience

  
**Advancing connectivity to secure a brighter world.**Nokia is a global leader in connectivity for the AI era. With expertise across fixed, mobile and transport networks, powered by the innovation of Nokia Bell Labs, we’re advancing connectivity to secure a brighter world.


Learn more about life at Nokia .

7099a21e.title: Technical Program Manager (TPM)
7099a21e.description:
We are looking for an experienced Technical Program Manager (TPM) to take end\-to\- end ownership of multiple concurrent software and technology projects, ensuring successful delivery across technology, people, processes, client expectations, and commercials.This is a technically driven program and delivery leadership role, not purely project coordination. The ideal candidate should have a strong software engineering/technical background, sound understanding of modern application architecture and cloud technologies, and proven experience managing multiple projects, cross\-functional teams, and client engagements. Experience in AI/ML, Generative AI, LLM, Agentic AI, or AI\-enabled project delivery will be an added advantage.


Key Responsibilities

* Own the end\-to\-end delivery of multiple projects/programs, from requirements, estimation and planning through development, UAT, deployment, and support transition.
* Manage scope, timelines, resources, budgets, dependencies, risks, quality, and delivery commitments across concurrent projects.
* Work closely with Architects and Technical Leads on solution design, estimations, architecture, integrations, and technology decisions.
* Review and challenge technical approaches to ensure solutions are scalable,secure, maintainable, and aligned with business requirements.
* Lead cross\-functional teams including Developers, Technical Leads, Architects,QA, DevOps, UI/UX, BA, AI/ML Engineers, and other specialists.
* Drive Agile/Scrum delivery, sprint/release planning, program governance, RAID management, and management reporting.
* Act as a key client interface for technical discussions, governance, status reviews, delivery commitments, and escalations.
* Proactively manage scope changes, delivery risks, dependencies, resource constraints, and client escalations.
* Monitor project/program financials including planned vs. actual effort, resource utilization, billing milestones, budgets, and delivery margins.
* Ensure adherence to engineering practices including code reviews, CI/CD,testing, security, documentation, release management, and production readiness.
* Support pre\-sales activities including requirement analysis, solution discussions, estimations, resource planning, SOWs, and technical proposals.
* Mentor Project Managers, Technical Leads, and senior team members while driving accountability, delivery discipline, and continuous improvement.


Technical Competencies


The candidate is not expected to code on a daily basis, but must be technically strong enough to understand, evaluate, and challenge engineering decisions.


Strong understanding of:

* Modern software development lifecycle and engineering practices
* Web and enterprise application architecture
* APIs, microservices, system integrations, and databases
* Cloud platforms such as AWS, Azure, or GCP
* DevOps, CI/CD, Git, containerization, and deployment processes
* Application security, performance, scalability, and production monitoring
* Agile/Scrum methodologies
* Exposure to AI/ML, Generative AI, LLMs, RAG, Agentic AI, or AI\-based solution delivery is an advantage
* Familiarity with AI tools, platforms, APIs, or frameworks such as OpenAI/Azure OpenAI, Gemini, Claude, LangChain, LlamaIndex, Hugging Face, or similar technologies is an added advantage
* Experience with technology stacks such as Java, .NET, Python, Node.js, PHP, ColdFusion, React, Angular, Vue, mobile technologies, or similar enterprise stacks will be advantageous.


Required Experience \& Skills

* 8–14 years of overall experience in software development/technology delivery.
* Minimum 5 years in Technical Project Management, Program Management, Delivery Management, or similar leadership roles.
* Proven experience managing multiple concurrent software projects and cross\-functional engineering teams.
* Prior hands\-on software development or strong technical engineering experience is highly preferred.
* Experience delivering medium\-to\-large projects for external/enterprise clients.
* Strong understanding of estimation, resource planning, project financials, utilization, and delivery margins.
* Experience delivering AI/ML or GenAI\-based projects will be a plus.
* Experience working with international clients, particularly North American, European, or Middle Eastern customers, is advantageous.
* Excellent client communication, stakeholder management, leadership,problem\-solving, and decision\-making skills.
* PMP/PRINCE2, Scrum/SAFe, AWS/Azure/GCP, ITIL, or similar certifications are advantageous but not mandatory.


Success Measures


Success will be measured through on\-time and within\-budget delivery across projects, project quality, client satisfaction, resource utilization, estimation accuracy, delivery margins, risk management, reduced escalations, team performance, and repeat business/account growth.


Ideal Candidate


A technically grounded program and delivery leader who can comfortably move between multiple project priorities, client discussions, architecture reviews, sprint/release planning, resource challenges, commercial concerns, and escalations.


The ideal candidate should be able to ask engineering teams the right technical questions, communicate complex issues to clients in business language, make practical delivery decisions, and take clear ownership of overall program and delivery outcomes.

**Job Type:** Full Time**Job Location:** Kochi

52d9f46c.description:
**About Us**
 Zelis is modernizing the healthcare financial experience in the United States (U.S.) across payers, providers, and healthcare consumers. Zelis sees across the system to identify, optimize, and solve problems holistically with technology built by healthcare experts – driving real, measurable results for clients.

This is a place for builders with a growth mindset who act with agility, embrace change, and use modern technology to shape smarter solutions, exceptional experiences, and the future of our industry for our clients, customers, and our culture.
   

  

**Why We Do What We Do**
 In the U.S., consumers, payers, and providers face significant challenges throughout the healthcare financial journey. Zelis helps streamline the process by offering solutions that improve transparency, efficiency, and communication among all parties involved. By addressing the obstacles that patients face in accessing care, navigating the intricacies of insurance claims, and the logistical challenges healthcare providers encounter with processing payments, Zelis aims to create a more seamless and effective healthcare financial system.
   

  

 Zelis India plays a crucial role in this mission by supporting various initiatives that enhance the healthcare financial experience. The local team contributes to the development and implementation of innovative solutions, ensuring that technology and processes are optimized for efficiency and effectiveness. Beyond operational expertise, Zelis India cultivates a collaborative work culture, leadership development, and global exposure, creating a dynamic environment for professional growth. With hybrid work flexibility, comprehensive healthcare benefits, financial wellness programs, and cultural celebrations, we foster a holistic workplace experience. Additionally, the team plays a vital role in maintaining high standards of service delivery and contributes to Zelis’ award\-winning culture.
   

  

**Position Overview**
 Technical Program Manager – AI\-Enabled Engineering Pods
   

  

 Role Title: Technical Program Manager – Full Stack, Cloud \& AI Engineering
   

  

 Location: Hyderabad, India
   

  

 Experience Required: Minimum 14\+ years of experience
   

  

 We are looking for a seasoned
 **Technical Program Manager** 
 to lead and manage multiple cross\-functional engineering pod teams based in Hyderabad. This role requires strong technical depth, hands\-on understanding of modern full stack engineering practices, cloud\-native platforms, DevSecOps, and practical experience using AI and Gen AI platforms to improve engineering productivity, delivery predictability, quality, and operational excellence.
   

  

 The ideal candidate should have prior experience managing complex technology programs involving distributed engineering teams, product owners, architects, developers, QA engineers, DevOps teams, security teams, and business stakeholders. The candidate must be comfortable operating at both strategic and execution levels — driving roadmap alignment, technical delivery, architecture discussions, release governance, dependency management, risk mitigation, and executive\-level reporting.
   

  

 This is not a pure project management role. The candidate is expected to bring strong technical judgment, understand engineering trade\-offs, challenge solution approaches where required, and guide teams toward scalable, secure, maintainable, and AI\-enabled delivery practices.
   

  

**Key Responsibilities**
**Program \& Delivery Leadership**
* Lead multiple engineering pod teams delivering full stack, cloud\-native, and enterprise\-grade digital applications.
* Own end\-to\-end program execution across planning, design, development, testing, release, deployment, and production support.
* Drive delivery predictability across multiple pods by managing scope, schedule, dependencies, risks, milestones, and release commitments.
* Partner with product owners, architects, engineering managers, QA leads, DevOps teams, security teams, and business stakeholders to ensure successful execution.
* Establish clear operating rhythms across sprint planning, backlog refinement, architecture reviews, dependency tracking, release planning, and production readiness.
* Monitor execution health across pods and proactively address blockers, capacity gaps, technical risks, and cross\-team dependencies.
* Drive alignment between business objectives, product priorities, technical architecture, and delivery execution.
* Ensure programs are delivered with strong focus on quality, security, scalability, maintainability, and operational stability.


**Technical Program Management**
* Facilitate technical design discussions across .NET Core, Angular, REST APIs, microservices, cloud platforms, databases, DevSecOps, and integration platforms.
* Partner with architects and senior engineers to validate solution approaches, identify architectural risks, and ensure adherence to enterprise standards.
* Drive technical governance across application architecture, API design, cloud integration, security, performance, observability, and deployment practices.
* Ensure engineering teams follow clean architecture, SOLID principles, secure coding practices, CI/CD standards, and cloud engineering best practices.
* Track and manage technical debt, platform modernization initiatives, production stability issues, and engineering improvement plans.
* Support teams in resolving production issues related to performance, scalability, reliability, integrations, cloud services, and deployment pipelines.
* Ensure delivery teams adopt appropriate engineering metrics, including sprint predictability, defect leakage, deployment frequency, change failure rate, code quality, test coverage, and production incident trends.


**AI \& Gen AI Enablement**
* Drive responsible adoption of AI and Gen AI tools across engineering pods to improve productivity, code quality, documentation, testing, and problem\-solving.
* Enable teams to use platforms such as GitHub Copilot, ChatGPT Enterprise, Azure OpenAI, Amazon Q, Gemini, or similar enterprise\-approved AI platforms.
* Identify practical AI use cases across software delivery, including code generation, refactoring, unit test generation, API documentation, technical design documentation, defect analysis, and security review support.
* Establish AI usage guardrails aligned with enterprise security, data privacy, compliance, intellectual property, and responsible AI policies.
* Partner with engineering and security teams to evaluate AI\-assisted development workflows and ensure safe adoption.
* Track productivity and quality improvements resulting from AI\-enabled engineering practices.
* Promote a culture of AI\-assisted engineering while ensuring human accountability for design, code quality, security, and production outcomes.


**Agile, DevSecOps \& Release Governance**
* Lead agile execution across multiple pods using Scrum, Kanban, SAFe, or hybrid delivery models.
* Drive consistent sprint ceremonies, backlog hygiene, estimation practices, release planning, and execution governance.
* Ensure CI/CD pipelines, automated deployments, quality gates, code reviews, test automation, security scans, and release approvals are integrated into delivery workflows.
* Partner with DevOps and platform teams to improve deployment reliability, environment stability, monitoring, logging, and incident response.
* Ensure production releases meet defined entry and exit criteria, including quality, security, performance, and operational readiness checks.
* Drive continuous improvement across engineering processes, agile maturity, DevSecOps adoption, and delivery effectiveness.


**Stakeholder \& Executive Communication**
* Provide clear, concise, and data\-driven program updates to senior leadership, including Directors, VPs, and CXO\-level stakeholders where required.
* Communicate program status, risks, dependencies, financial impacts, delivery trade\-offs, and mitigation plans with appropriate executive clarity.
* Prepare roadmap views, release dashboards, dependency maps, risk registers, decision logs, and program health reports.
* Translate complex technical topics into business\-relevant insights for non\-technical stakeholders.
* Drive decision\-making across competing priorities, delivery constraints, architecture options, and risk scenarios.


**Required Skills And Experience**
* Minimum 14\+ years of overall technology experience, with strong background in software engineering, technical delivery, program management, or engineering leadership.
* Proven experience managing multiple engineering pods or cross\-functional agile teams in a complex enterprise environment.
* Strong technical understanding of full stack application delivery using .NET Core / ASP.NET Core, Angular, C\#, TypeScript, JavaScript, HTML, and CSS.
* Solid understanding of REST APIs, microservices, backend services, cloud\-native application patterns, and scalable web architectures.
* Experience working with AWS and/or Azure cloud platforms.
* Strong understanding of relational databases such as SQL Server, PostgreSQL, or MySQL.
* Good understanding of application security, authentication, authorization, identity management, logging, monitoring, and performance optimization.
* Experience with CI/CD pipelines, DevSecOps practices, Git\-based workflows, automated deployment, and production release governance.
* Working knowledge of containerization and orchestration platforms such as Docker and Kubernetes.
* Familiarity with event\-driven systems and messaging platforms such as Azure Service Bus, AWS SQS/SNS, Kafka, or RabbitMQ.
* Experience with Infrastructure as Code tools such as Terraform, ARM templates, Bicep, or AWS CloudFormation.
* Practical experience using AI or Gen AI platforms such as GitHub Copilot, ChatGPT, Azure OpenAI, Amazon Q, Gemini, or equivalent tools.
* Strong understanding of agile delivery models, sprint execution, roadmap planning, dependency management, and engineering metrics.
* Ability to challenge technical assumptions, identify delivery risks, and drive resolution across engineering, product, QA, DevOps, security, and business teams.
* Excellent communication skills with ability to engage senior leadership and technical teams with equal effectiveness.


**Preferred Technical Capabilities**
* Prior hands\-on software engineering experience before moving into technical program management or engineering leadership.
* Experience managing enterprise\-scale modernization, cloud migration, platform transformation, or digital product engineering programs.
* Exposure to regulated industries such as healthcare, fintech, insurance, life sciences, or other compliance\-heavy environments.
* Strong understanding of enterprise architecture governance, security reviews, audit requirements, and compliance controls.
* Experience with observability platforms, production support models, SRE practices, and incident management.
* Experience implementing AI\-assisted SDLC practices across large engineering teams.
* Understanding of responsible AI, AI governance, data privacy, secure prompt usage, and enterprise AI adoption frameworks.


**AI Platform Expectations**
 The candidate should be hands\-on and comfortable using AI platforms to:
   

  

* Improve engineering productivity across multiple pod teams.
* Assist with code review, code generation, and refactoring analysis.
* Generate unit test cases and improve test coverage.
* Support API documentation, architecture documentation, and technical design documentation.
* Analyze technical designs, logs, defects, and production issues for faster triage.
* Identify security, performance, and maintainability concerns in application delivery.
* Build reusable AI\-enabled workflows for engineering teams.
* Promote responsible AI adoption in alignment with enterprise policies.
* Ensure AI tools are used as productivity accelerators while preserving engineering accountability, security, and compliance.


**Leadership \& Soft Skills**
* Strong ownership mindset with ability to operate independently in a senior leadership\-facing role.
* Excellent stakeholder management, negotiation, and conflict\-resolution skills.
* Ability to lead multiple teams through ambiguity, changing priorities, and complex dependencies.
* Strong analytical and problem\-solving skills.
* Ability to balance delivery speed with technical quality, security, scalability, and maintainability.
* Strong communication skills with ability to simplify complex technical issues for executive audiences.
* Ability to mentor pod leads, scrum masters, technical leads, and engineering teams on delivery discipline and engineering best practices.
* Strong execution discipline with focus on measurable outcomes, delivery transparency, and continuous improvement.


**Commitment to Diversity, Equity, Inclusion, and Belonging**
 At Zelis, we champion diversity, equity, inclusion, and belonging in all aspects of our operations. We embrace the power of diversity and create an environment where people can bring their authentic and best selves to work. We know that a sense of belonging is key not only to your success at Zelis, but also to your ability to bring your best each day.
   

  

**Equal Employment Opportunity**
 Zelis is proud to be an equal opportunity employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, age, sex, national origin, disability status, genetics, protected veteran status, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, or any other characteristic protected by federal, state or local laws.
   

  

**Accessibility Support**
 We are dedicated to ensuring our application process is accessible to all candidates. If you are a qualified individual with a disability and require reasonable accommodation with any part of the application and/or interview process, please email talentacquisition@zelis.com.

f6b8f99b.description:
**LotusFlare** 
 is a provider of cloud\-native SaaS products based in the heart of Silicon Valley. Founded by the team that helped Facebook reach over one billion users, LotusFlare was founded to make affordable mobile communications available to everyone on Earth.
   

  

 Today, LotusFlare focuses on designing, building, and continuously evolving a digital commerce and monetization platform that delivers valuable outcomes for enterprises. Our platform, Digital Network Operator® (DNO™) Cloud, is licensed to telecommunications services providers and supports millions of customers globally.
   

  

 LotusFlare has also designed and built the leading eSIM travel product \- Nomad. Nomad provides global travelers with high\-speed, affordable data connectivity in over 190 countries. Nomad is available as an iOS or Android app or via getnomad.app.

* Support project management activities, ensuring issues are documented and addressed.
* Be a part of a Global Delivery Team, share experiences and develop the project management discipline: simplify processes, methods, and tools with creative ideas.
* Aid in product design and product development.
* Build a team and lead a team of client engagement managers serving our clients.


**Requirements**

* 8\+ years of experience in management consulting, enterprise software, or startups.
* Deep expertise in industries such as mobile and fixed telecommunications, media and technology.
* Experience in managing engagement and projects with Mobile Operators related to digital initiatives including Business Support System (BSS) digitization is a plus.
* Functional knowledge, including but not limited to strategy, project management, and product management.
* Proven track record of performance leading delivery of complex digital solutions, on time and within budget.
* Exceptional analytical and quantitative problem\-solving skills. Able to distill data and articulate the rationale for making difficult trade\-offs.
* Demonstrated leadership ability in an international team environment.
* Initiative taker, eager to break new ground, create opportunities for others, and a quick learner.

**Benefits We Have For You**

**Position: Principal Technical Program Manager** 




**Location: Hyderabad/Remote** 




**Availability: Immediate joiner** 




  





**Context Engine is one of the most strategically significant and technically complex program. It is not a single product — it is a governed enterprise data foundation that spans ingestion, semantic modeling, metadata management, and runtime access patterns across the platform. It sits at the intersection of data engineering, AI/ML infrastructure, and enterprise data governance, with dependencies that run horizontally across nearly every other product and platform initiative.** 




**This role requires a Technical Program Manager with the depth and maturity to operate in an environment where the technical surface is wide, the stakeholder map is broad, and the margin for ambiguity is low. This is not a coordination role. It requires direct technical engagement, the ability to drive architectural and delivery decisions, and the judgment to know when to escalate versus resolve.** 




  





**What You'll Do** 



* Own the Context Engine program plan end\-to\-end — workstream decomposition, dependency mapping, milestone sequencing, and delivery tracking across engineering, data platform, and product teams.
* Engage directly with engineering leads and architects to understand technical scope, surface cross\-team dependencies early, and drive resolution of blockers that require cross\-functional input.
* Define and enforce program\-level delivery processes — including sprint\-to\-release mapping, shift\-left testing integration, incremental delivery gates, and release readiness criteria.
* Manage the dependency surface between Context Engine and adjacent programs including Agentic Memory, ADP, Elastic Compute, and Fabric as a Service — maintaining clear interfaces, handoff criteria, and escalation paths.
* Drive the program toward a high\-frequency, incremental release cadence — identifying and eliminating the structural, process, and coordination bottlenecks that prevent teams from delivering continuously.
* Own program\-level risk management: identifying technical and organizational risks early, quantifying their delivery impact, and driving mitigation with appropriate urgency and specificity.
* Build and maintain the authoritative tracking artifact for Context Engine — a single leadership\-visible view of workstream health, milestone status, open risks, and decisions needed.
* Lead design partner and early adopter coordination — translating customer feedback into structured input for engineering prioritization and validating that delivered capabilities meet intended use cases.
* Represent Context Engine program status in leadership reviews — communicating with precision, flagging risk without ambiguity, and driving decisions rather than deferring them.
* Contribute to program management practice development — establishing reusable templates, delivery frameworks, and operating norms that raise the floor across the broader TPM organization.



  





**What Success Looks Like** 



* Context Engine ships on a consistent, predictable cadence with engineering teams operating in a coordinated rhythm and leadership maintaining real\-time confidence in delivery.
* Cross\-program dependencies are managed proactively — adjacent program teams know what Context Engine will deliver, when, and to what interface spec, with no surprises at integration.
* The program has a single source of truth that is trusted by engineering, product, and leadership — with status that reflects reality, not optimism.
* Design partners receive structured, high\-quality engagement that generates actionable feedback loops — and that feedback demonstrably influences delivery priorities.
* The TPM is recognized across the organization as a senior thought partner by both engineering and product leadership — not just a program tracker, but a delivery force multiplier.



  





**Who You'll Work With** 




 You will work closely with engineering managers, platform architects, data engineers, and product managers across the Context Engine workstreams. You will also maintain active coordination with GPMs and TPMs across adjacent programs, and engage directly with senior leadership on program health, risks, and strategic decisions. External design partner engagement is a regular part of the role.
 



  





**Non\-Negotiable Qualifications** 



* 10\+ years of technical program management experience in the tech industry, with a track record of owning complex, multi\-team, horizontally scoped programs.
* Deep technical fluency in data platform, data infrastructure, or AI/ML systems — sufficient to engage meaningfully with architects and engineers on design decisions, integration interfaces, and technical tradeoffs.
* Demonstrated experience driving programs with a high degree of ambiguity, broad stakeholder surface, and significant cross\-team dependency management.
* Strong command of delivery frameworks — agile, incremental delivery, shift\-left testing, release management — and the judgment to apply them pragmatically rather than dogmatically.
* Proven ability to build trust and influence across engineering leadership, product management, and executive stakeholders without direct authority.
* Exceptional written and verbal communication — able to distill complex technical and program status into crisp, decision\-ready narratives for senior audiences.
* Bachelor's degree in computer science, engineering, or a related technical discipline required.

42268193.title: Staff Program Manager – Engineering Readiness, Onboarding, & APAC Enablement
42268193.description:
LinkedIn is the world's largest professional network, built to create economic opportunity for every member of the global workforce. Our products help people make powerful connections, discover exciting opportunities, build necessary skills, and gain valuable insights every day. We're also committed to providing transformational opportunities for our own employees by investing in their growth. We aspire to create a culture that's built on trust, care, inclusion, and fun – where everyone can succeed.
   

  





 Join us to transform the way the world works.
   

  

  

  




**Job Description**

 Hiring Team Description: We are seeking a Staff Program Manager (IC4\) with strong technical acumen, leadership, and influencing skills to lead Engineering Readiness \& APAC Delivery across LinkedIn Engineering onboarding and enablement programs.
   

  





 This role sits within the Engineering Chief of Staff (CoS) organization, which drives strategic programs across Engineering and Infrastructure. The TPM will partner closely with senior engineering leaders to define and operationalize how engineers ramp, develop critical capabilities, and become productive at scale.
   

  





 This is a high\-impact role that connects central strategy with execution, particularly in Bangalore/APAC, while shaping a globally consistent onboarding and readiness model. The role is centered on a critical question: What do engineers need to be successful, and how do we build them effectively and at scale?
   

  





 The ideal candidate combines strong technical program leadership, systems thinking, and the ability to influence senior technical stakeholders. They are comfortable operating in ambiguity and passionate about developing engineering talent through scalable onboarding, learning, and enablement programs that accelerate readiness, growth, and time\-to\-productivity.
   

  





 At LinkedIn, our approach to flexible work is centered on trust and optimized for culture, connection, clarity, and the evolving needs of our business. The work location of this role is hybrid, meaning it will be performed both from home and from a LinkedIn office on select days, as determined by the business needs of the team.
   

  





 Responsibilities:
   

  





 Strategy \& Readiness
   

  




* Define what engineers need to succeed and translate them into clear onboarding and readiness expectations


* Align capability priorities with Central Engineering and Infrastructure strategy in partnership with the Engineering CoS team.



 Gap Identification \& Prioritization
   

  




* Identify knowledge or capability gaps across roles (e.g., SWE, DS, TPM) and regions through onboarding data, feedback, and engineering insights.


* Prioritize investments based on impact to engineering effectiveness and time\-to\-productivity.



 Enablement System Design
   

  




* Design scalable enablement systems that develop critical engineering capabilities


* Work with SMEs to translate capability needs into effective learning experiences, including:


* AI\-native onboarding and bootcamps


* Role\-based learning pathways


* Readiness frameworks and assessments


* Experiential, peer\-based, and on\-the\-job learning opportunities


* Ensure onboarding operates as an integrated system rather than a collection of disconnected programs.


* Apply measurement and continuous improvement practices to evaluate learning effectiveness and business impact.



 Technical Onboarding \& Content
   

  




* Own and contribute to building the onboarding roadmap from the AI first lens


* Partner with Staff\+ engineers and subject matter experts to align and evolve onboarding with real\-world engineering workflows and expectations.



 APAC Delivery \& Activation
   

  




* Lead onboarding delivery across APAC, ensuring programs are effective, scalable, and regionally relevant.


* Adapt enablement approaches to local needs, including facilitator models, structured learning experiences, and delivery mechanisms.


* Build and enable a network of facilitators and SMEs to reinforce key capabilities at scale.



 Insights \& Continuous Improvement
   

  




* Establish feedback loops that inform capability strategy, content evolution, and program design.


* Provide data\-driven recommendations to leadership on improving engineering readiness and onboarding outcomes.


* Serve as a bridge between Engineering CoS strategy and execution, aligning stakeholders across Engineering, Dev Productivity, Security, HR, and Operations.



  

  

  

  




**Qualifications**

 Basic Qualifications:
   

  




* 8\+ years of experience in program management in a technical space, engineering enablement, onboarding, learning and development, or related disciplines.


* Proven experience defining critical capabilities or skills and translating them into scalable programs, frameworks, or systems.


* Experience partnering with engineering leaders and technical stakeholders to solve complex, ambiguous problems.


* Experience using quantitative and qualitative data to identify gaps, drive prioritization, and measure impact.



 Preferred Qualifications:
   

  




* Experience building or leading engineering onboarding, technical training, capability\-building, or talent development programs at scale.


* Strong understanding of adult learning principles, learning program design, and behavior\-change strategies that drive skill acquisition and performance.


* Passion for developing engineering talent and creating environments that enable individuals and teams to grow and succeed.


* Strong understanding of modern engineering practices, including:


* AI\-assisted development


* Developer productivity


* Infrastructure and platform engineering


* Experience defining or influencing:


* Capability frameworks and readiness models


* Learning strategies and onboarding standards


* Demonstrated ability to move from ambiguous problem statements to capability definition and scalable solutions.


* Experience working across global regions, particularly APAC/Bangalore, and adapting enablement strategies to local needs.


* Experience building facilitator\- or SME\-driven delivery models.


* Strong systems\-thinking skills with the ability to design end\-to\-end enablement ecosystems.



 Suggested Skills:
   

  




* Software Engineering


* Product Management


* Technical Program Management


* Engineering Enablement \& Capability Building


* Learning \& Development Strategy


* Talent Development


* Cross\-functional Leadership


* Stakeholder Management


* Program \& Systems Design


* Facilitation \& Delivery Models


* Change Management


* AI \& Engineering Readiness

 380209
   

  

 NTT DATA strives to hire exceptional, innovative and passionate individuals who want to grow with us. If you want to be part of an inclusive, adaptable, and forward\-thinking organization, apply now.
   

  

 We are currently seeking a ServiceNow \- Enterprise /Platform Architect Intermediate to join our team in Delhi, Delhi (IN\-DL), India (IN).
   

  

 Job Title: ServiceNow \- Enterprise / Platform Architect
   

  

 Location: Remote (with occasional travel as needed)
   

  

 Role Overview:
   

  

 NTT DATA is seeking a dynamic and experienced ServiceNow \- Enterprise / Platform Architect who combines deep technical expertise with strategic advisory capabilities. This role involves hands\-on configuration and development across all major ServiceNow modules, while also contributing to pre\-sales efforts including proposal development and crafting Statements of Work (SOWs). The ideal candidate will be a trusted advisor to clients, helping them maximize their ServiceNow investments through strategic roadmaps, platform governance, and process optimization.

 Advisory \& Strategic Consulting
   

  

* Lead client engagements to assess current ServiceNow capabilities and define future\-state process and platform strategies.
* Develop platform roadmaps aligned with business goals and technical priorities.
* Conduct business value assessments and recommend adoption strategies across ITSM, ITOM, ITAM (any one).
* Design and implement governance models, KPIs, and process improvement frameworks.
* Facilitate client workshops to gather requirements, align stakeholders, and drive consensus on solution design and implementation plans.
* Apply deep business process knowledge to map client needs to ServiceNow capabilities and identify opportunities for automation and optimization.


 Technical Implementation \& Platform Expertise
   

  

* Configure and customize ServiceNow modules including Incident, Problem, Change, Knowledge, CMDB, Discovery and more.

* Support pricing strategies and resource planning for advisory and implementation phases.

**Role Summary**
 Support managed services delivery for Sprinklr Community customers by configuring, optimizing, and maintaining brand communities, discussion forums, and digital engagement experiences. Focus on operational excellence, platform governance, customer support, community growth, and continuous platform adoption.
   

  

**What You’ll Do**
* Manage day\-to\-day support and administration of Sprinklr Community platforms, ensuring operational stability and adherence to SLAs.
* Configure and maintain community structures including forums, discussion boards, categories, topics, user groups, gamification, moderation workflows, and permissions.
* Execute platform enhancements, configuration changes, and optimization initiatives aligned to customer requirements and best practices.
* Support community moderation processes, including content triaging, escalation management, agent assignment, and user governance.
* Troubleshoot platform, user access, workflow, content visibility, notification, and engagement\-related issues.
* Monitor community health, user engagement, adoption metrics, and operational performance, recommending improvement opportunities.
* Support branding, page configurations, templates, widgets, navigation, and UI/UX enhancements using HTML, CSS, and JavaScript.
* Assist with API\-based integrations and data exchanges with third\-party platforms, CRM systems, SSO providers, and digital ecosystems.
* Collaborate with customer stakeholders to gather requirements, recommend best practices, and deliver configuration\-led solutions.
* Provide post\-go\-live support, enhancement management, platform governance, and release validation activities.
* Develop and maintain operational documentation, knowledge articles, runbooks, and community administration guides.
* Support user onboarding, training, and adoption programs to maximize platform utilization and business value.


**What Makes You Qualified?**
**Must Have Qualifications**
* 5\-8 years of experience in Managed Services, SaaS Platform Support, Community Management, or Digital Experience platforms.
* Hands\-on experience with Sprinklr Community or similar platforms such as Khoros, Gainsight, Salesforce Experience Cloud, Zendesk Communities, or Higher Logic.
* Experience configuring workflows, user roles, permissions, moderation processes, community structures, and governance controls.
* Working knowledge of HTML, CSS, JavaScript, and web content management concepts.
* Understanding of REST APIs, JSON, authentication mechanisms, and integration troubleshooting.
* Strong analytical, troubleshooting, incident management, and stakeholder communication skills.
* Experience working in customer\-facing environments with ownership of service delivery and operational outcomes.


**Good To Have Skills**
* Experience managing brand communities, customer support forums, knowledge communities, or advocacy programs.
* Familiarity with SSO, OAuth, webhooks, and CRM integrations.
* Knowledge of SEO, accessibility, and community engagement best practices.
* Experience with ticketing and project management tools such as Jira, Azure DevOps, or ServiceNow.
* Exposure to digital customer experience, customer success, or online community operations.


**Who You Are**
* Customer\-focused with a strong managed services mindset.
* Detail\-oriented and proactive in identifying operational improvements.
* Comfortable balancing technical troubleshooting with business stakeholder engagement.
* A collaborative consultant who takes ownership of customer outcomes and platform success.


**What Success Looks Like**
* Stable and optimized community operations.
* High SLA adherence and timely issue resolution.
* Increased platform adoption and community engagement.
* Well\-governed, scalable, and user\-friendly community experiences.
* Strong customer satisfaction and stakeholder confidence.


**We focus on our mission** 
 : Sprinklr was founded in 2009 to solve a big problem: growing enterprise complexity that separated brands from their customers. Our vision was clear: to unify fragmented teams, tools and data — helping large organizations build deeper, more meaningful connections with the people they serve. Today, Sprinklr has a unified, AI\-native platform for four product suites: Sprinklr Service, Sprinklr Social, Sprinklr Marketing, and Sprinklr Insights. Sprinklr is here to do three things:
   

  

* Lead a new category of enterprise software that we call Unified\-CXM.
* Empower companies to deliver next generation, unified engagement journeys that reimagine the customer experience.
* Create a culture of customer obsession, with trust, teamwork, and accountability.


**We believe in our product** 
 : Customers who value exceptional customer experiences have what they need on our single unified platform, built with an operating system approach on a single codebase. That means that everything — and everyone — can work together to service, respond, sell, and market to customers on the channels they prefer. While Unified Customer Experience Management (Unified\-CXM) as a category is just getting started, we are well on our way to creating a no\-compromise, unified approach to better customer experiences for the world’s leading enterprise brands.
   

  

**We invest in our people** 
 : We offer a comprehensive suite of benefits designed to help each member of our team thrive. Sprinklr believes that you should be able to get the type of care you need for your personal well\-being when you need it. We offer you and your family voluntary healthcare coverage in countries where applicable. We believe it is important to take time off – it is essential for your mental and physical wellbeing. We provide Sprinklrites with paid time off to recharge and spend time with loved ones. We want to grow our talent with purpose. Our open Mentoring Program is designed to create meaningful connections that support growth and amplify our focus.
   

  

 To learn more about employee benefits by region, click here.
   

  

 To learn more about all\-things\-Sprinklr, visit our candidate resource hub here.
   

  

**EEO \- Our philosophy** 
 : Our goal is to ensure every employee feels like they belong and are operating in a collaborative environment. We fervently believe every employee matters and should be respected and heard. We believe we are stronger when we belong because collectively, we’re more innovative, creative, and successful.
   

  

 Sprinklr is proud to be an equal\-opportunity workplace and complies with all applicable federal, state, and local fair employment practices laws. We are committed to equal employment opportunity regardless of race, color, religion, creed, national origin or ancestry, ethnicity, sex (including gender, pregnancy, sexual orientation, and gender identity), age, physical or mental disability, citizenship, past, current, or prospective service in the uniformed services, genetic information, or any other characteristic protected under applicable law.
   

  

 Reasonable accommodations are available upon request during the interview process. To request an accommodation, please work directly with your recruitment coordinator or recruiter.
   

  

**Warning about Recruiting Scams:** 
 Please be vigilant for recruiting scams impersonating Sprinklr. Sprinklr will never ask you for money, to pay for equipment, or for unnecessary personal information during the interview process. Sprinklr will also never pay in Bitcoin or send email communications from our executives. Please review the Federal Trade Commission's advice to avoid these types of scams.
   

  

 If you are contacted by someone whom you suspect may not be appropriately representing Sprinklr, please do not engage and block their email or phone number immediately.

ccb5c3e0.title: Technical Program Manager, Payee Management
ccb5c3e0.description:
**Description**
 Amazon's Accounts Payables Technology team, part of FinAuto (Finance Automation), is transforming financial operations through next\-generation automation powered by agentic AI. We process trillions in annual transactions across every Amazon business worldwide, including AWS, Stores, and Digital. Our team is building intelligent systems that optimize the entire order\-to\-cash lifecycle, from sales through billing and collections. We're seeking a hands\-on technical leader to drive our automation vision forward.
   

  

 As Amazon's financial operations grow exponentially with business expansion, traditional approaches to scaling through human operations are no longer sufficient. Our team is at the forefront of solving this challenge through innovative automation solutions that combine artificial intelligence, machine learning, and enterprise\-grade workflows to transform how financial operations work.
   

  

 As a Technical Program manager,
   

  

* You are responsible for managing the lifecycle of a complex cross\-functional program with considerable impact.
* Your program may focus on a single product in a critical technology area or you may work more broadly, managing larger initiatives that span organizations or geographies in support of a larger business objective.
* You may also be responsible for the delivery of large and complex projects that may or may not be tied to a larger program.
* You may be assigned to manage the roadmap for an organization, which may include contributing to OP1/OP2 narratives, and ownership of one or more organizational goals.
* As a senior technology program owner, you are accountable for the overall strategy as well as driving teams inside and outside your organization to deliver.
* You are able to define the program (mission, vision, tenets), set objectives, analyze data, drive improvements that are quantified with metrics, and influence resource allocation.
* You understand the systems in your product or program space, their limitations, scaling factors, boundary conditions, and reasons behind architectural decisions


 Key job responsibilities
   

  

* To ensure business and technical stakeholder needs are aligned, you drive mindful discussions that lead to crisp decisions.
* You provide context (past, current, and future) for business/technology choices and a long\-term perspective.
* You partner with customers and engineering teams to determine which projects move forward and in what priority order.
* You use your technical judgment to question proposals and test assumptions (Q. Do we need to build this at all?).
* You enlist Senior/Principal Engineer to ensure architecture(s) scale (or will scale) to match the “think big” business case.
* You make smart trade\-offs (e.g., time vs. effort vs. features).
* You create plans that have clear, measurable success criteria. You clearly communicate progress and outcomes.
* You oversee the gap between teams, processes, and system architectures. You help teams/your organization reduce exposure to classic failure modes (e.g., requirements not sufficiently understood/documented, ineffective cross\-team collaboration, long\-term impact(s) from of the use of third\-party technologies, APIs not protected/hardened, insufficient testing/gaps in QA).
* You solve ambiguous problems and proactively identify and mitigate risks (before they become roadblocks). You demonstrate good judgment in how and when to escalate (without damaging relationships).
* You are data\-driven. You regularly review metrics and proactively seek out new and improved data/mechanisms for visibility. You ensure your program stays aligned with organizational objectives.
* You understand technical program management and engineering best practices. You may be asked to use your knowledge to assess development processes, test plans, and operations/maintenance requirements.
* You work with teams to improve concurrent project delivery. You streamline and/or eliminate excess process.
* You influence teams to decouple from dependencies and eliminate architecture problems that stifle innovation or cause user dissatisfaction, development collisions, and/or outages.
* You are an excellent communicator. You write effective narratives (Amazon 6\-pager) and present them effectively to Directors and VPs. You routinely deliver the right things with limited guidance. \* When confronted with discordant views, you are able to find the best way forward and influence others to follow that path (build consensus).


**Basic Qualifications**
* 5\+ years of technical product or program management experience
* 7\+ years of working directly with engineering teams experience
* 3\+ years of software development experience
* 5\+ years of technical program management working directly with software engineering teams experience
* Experience managing programs across cross functional teams, building processes and coordinating release schedules


**Preferred Qualifications**
* 5\+ years of project management disciplines including scope, schedule, budget, quality, along with risk and critical path management experience
* Experience managing projects across cross functional teams, building sustainable processes and coordinating release schedules
* Experience defining KPI's/SLA's used to drive multi\-million dollar businesses and reporting to senior leadership


 Our inclusive culture empowers Amazonians to deliver the best results for our customers. If you have a disability and need a workplace accommodation or adjustment during the application and hiring process, including support for the interview or onboarding process, please visit https://amazon.jobs/content/en/how\-we\-hire/accommodations for more information. If the country/region you’re applying in isn’t listed, please contact your Recruiting Partner.
