b0e057cf.description:
****Company:****
 Qualcomm India Private Limited
   

  

****Job Area:****
 Engineering Services Group, Engineering Services Group \> Program Management
   

  

****General Summary:****
 The Qualcomm Datacenter team is developing hardware and software solutions spanning the data center, edge, infrastructure, automotive market. Qualcomm’s Cloud products are currently deployed at several large organizations. We are rapidly expanding for large scale deployments and are hiring across many disciplines. This position is an excellent opportunity to work on the latest cutting\-edge software, hardware technologies and is part of Chipset SW Program Management support and leadership for managing planning, development and delivery of software that spans across multiple technology areas across Qualcomm for Data Center Products.
   

  

****Job Overview:****
 Develops, defines, and executes plans of record, including schedules, budgets, resources, deliverables, and risks that includes. Monitors and drives the programs from initiation through delivery, interfacing with internal and external stakeholders across functions on technical matters. Monitors budget/spending, on\-time delivery, and achievement of program milestones. Represents the program and drives alignment across stakeholders.
   

  

****Preferred Qualifications:****
* Master's degree in engineering, computer Science, or related field.
* 5\+ years of Program Management or related work experience.
* 3\+ years of experience working with digital SOC and/or mixed\-signal baseband and/or RF chips
* 3\+ years of experience in a role requiring interaction with senior leadership (e.g., Director level and above).
* 2\+ years of experience working in a large matrixed organization.
* 2\+ years of experience with program management tools such as dashboards, Gantt charts, etc.
* 2\+ years of Engineering experience on CPU and AI products or applications
* Note: Only candidates with direct experience in semiconductor development and/or manufacturing experience will be considered.


****Principal Duties And Responsibilities:****
* Collaborates with key stakeholders and program sponsors to develop goals, set the prioritization of deliverables, and discuss necessary priorities and stakeholder needs.
* Manages and takes responsibility for multiple small programs/technology with moderate complexity or a single complex program/technology by applying up\-to\-date program management knowledge to meet deadlines.
* Develops and manages the execution of the program Plan of Record (e.g., on time, on budget, within scope) which includes schedule and resource forecasting, stakeholder identification, method and frequency of communication, scope, and prioritization.
* Tracks and manages all key metrics pertaining to a program and identifies when metrics deviate significantly from Plan of Record; escalates issues in a timely manner and proposes corrective actions.
* Manages and prioritizes the work of the program team by establishing schedules, task assignments, and tracking tasks of team members.
* Identifies program issues/risks and creates risk mitigation plans. Maintains and updates the risk tracker.
* Helps to promote program vision and objectives within own team and ensures program objectives are met or exceeded.
* Supports the adoption of processes by applying best practices and identifying and recommending process improvement opportunities within respective programs.


****Minimum Qualifications:****
* Bachelor's degree in engineering, computer Science, or related field.
* 4\+ years of Program Management or related work experience.
* 8\+ years of semiconductor, SoC, firmware, embedded software, system software, platform software, or related development experience.
* Direct experience managing semiconductor or SoC software development programs is required. Demonstrated leadership of software development, software readiness, firmware, \&/ platform execution for complex semiconductor products involving hardware\-software co\-development.
* Experience driving execution across architecture, silicon, firmware, validation, and software organizations through product release.


**This role is specifically targeted at leaders with demonstrated experience driving semiconductor software development, software readiness, firmware development, platform software, silicon bring\-up, validation, and productization for complex SoC products**
**Preferred Candidate Profile**
 The strongest candidates for this role typically have direct semiconductor software development and SoC program execution experience and will meet Minimum qualifications stated above. Backgrounds primarily focused on the following areas are generally NOT aligned with the core requirements of this position:
   

  

* Dedicated Program/Project Management, PMO, Scrum Master, operations management, or PMP\-focused roles lacking direct ownership and execution of semiconductor, SoC, firmware, platform software, or software development programs.
* Enterprise Software, SaaS, Web Applications, Business Applications, and Enterprise IT Systems.
* IT Infrastructure, Cloud Operations, Production Operations, Deployment Engineering, and Software Upgrade or Migration Programs.
* Sustaining/deployment Engineering/Operations or Non\-Semiconductor Software Development environments.


****Minimum Qualifications:****
* Bachelor's degree in Engineering, Computer Science, or related field.
* 5\+ years of Program Management or related work experience.


**Applicants** 
 : Qualcomm is an equal opportunity employer. If you are an individual with a disability and need an accommodation during the application/hiring process, rest assured that Qualcomm is committed to providing an accessible process. You may e\-mail disability\-accomodations@qualcomm.com or call Qualcomm's toll\-free number found here. Upon request, Qualcomm will provide reasonable accommodations to support individuals with disabilities to be able participate in the hiring process. Qualcomm is also committed to making our workplace accessible for individuals with disabilities. (Keep in mind that this email address is used to provide reasonable accommodations for individuals with disabilities. We will not respond here to requests for updates on applications or resume inquiries).
   

  

 Qualcomm expects its employees to abide by all applicable policies and procedures, including but not limited to security and other requirements regarding protection of Company confidential information and other confidential and/or proprietary information, to the extent those requirements are permissible under applicable law.
   

  

**To all Staffing and Recruiting Agencies** 
 : Our Careers Site is only for individuals seeking a job at Qualcomm. Staffing and recruiting agencies and individuals being represented by an agency are not authorized to use this site or to submit profiles, applications or resumes, and any such submissions will be considered unsolicited. Qualcomm does not accept unsolicited resumes or applications from agencies. Please do not forward resumes to our jobs alias, Qualcomm employees or any other company location. Qualcomm is not responsible for any fees related to unsolicited resumes/applications.
   

  

 If you would like more information about this role, please contact Qualcomm Careers.

5f4becca.title: Partner Solutions Engineer
5f4becca.description:
**About Us**
 Automation Anywhere is the leader in Agentic Process Automation (APA), transforming how work gets done with AI\-powered automation. Its APA system, built on the industry’s first Process Reasoning Engine (PRE) and specialized AI agents, combines process discovery, RPA, end\-to\-end orchestration, document processing, and analytics—all delivered with enterprise\-grade security and governance. Guided by its vision to fuel the future of work, Automation Anywhere helps organizations worldwide boost productivity, accelerate growth, and unleash human potential.
   

  

 Location : Bangalore , Mumbai , Delhi
   

  

 Experience \- 10 \+ Years
   

  

**Our Opportunity**
 Automation Anywhere is redefining how enterprises work through Agentic Process Automation (APA) — AI\-native agents that automate complex, end\-to\-end business processes. Our partner ecosystem is central to how we reach and serve global enterprises, and we are looking for a Partner Solutions Engineer to be the technical cornerstone of that motion.
   

  

 In this role, you will work directly alongside our Global System Integrator (GSI) and regional SI/VAR partners to win strategic deals at the intersection of ITSM and Agentic Automation. You are not a back\-office resource — you are the most senior AA technical voice in the room on partner\-led opportunities, guiding both the partner and the customer to a successful technical close.
   

  

**You Will Make an Impact By**
**Owning Technical Success In Partner\-Led Deals**
* Lead technical strategy and execution on high\-priority ITSM and APA opportunities sourced and co\-sold through GSI and regional SI/VAR partners — from discovery and architecture through POC and close.
* Serve as the definitive Automation Anywhere technical authority in partner\-led customer engagements, ensuring solutions are designed for business impact, not just technical correctness.
* Co\-develop tailored solution architectures that integrate Automation Anywhere's APA platform with other platforms, demonstrating clear ROI and measurable outcomes for enterprise customers.


**Driving Deal Strategy**
* Position AA's agentic automation capabilities including AI agents, LLM\-powered workflows, and intelligent document processing within transformation narratives that resonate with both business and IT stakeholders.
* Design and lead compelling POCs and technical workshops that accelerate partner deal cycles and validate AA as the platform of choice.
* Provide competitive technical advocacy in deals, equipping partners with the differentiated positioning needed to win against competitors.


**Elevating Partner Technical Capability**
* Coach and mentor partner SEs on deal strategy, solution design, and demo best practices. Raise the quality of the partner\-led technical motion without taking the wheel away from them.
* Build and contribute to partner\-ready solution assets: reference architectures, use case playbooks, integration blueprints, and battlecards.
* Serve as the escalation point for complex technical challenges that exceed partner SE capacity, ensuring no deal is lost due to technical gaps.


**Operating As a Strategic Voice**
* Engage C\-suite and senior IT leadership at customer organizations, articulating the strategic value of an AI\-native automation platform within enterprise ITSM and service delivery transformation.
* Represent Automation Anywhere at partner events, QBRs, and industry forums, reinforcing Automation Anywhere's thought leadership in Agentic Automation and ITSM.
* Channel partner and market intelligence: competitive signals, technology gaps, emerging use cases and back into AA's product, alliance, and go\-to\-market teams.


**Architecting Scalable Partner Solutions**
* Design reusable solution frameworks and integration patterns that enable GSI and regional SI partners to replicate AA value across their customer portfolios — multiplying deal impact beyond direct engagement.
* Stay at the forefront of agentic AI, LLM orchestration, RAG, and MCP standards, translating emerging capabilities into concrete partner\-ready solutions.


**You Will Be a Great Fit If You Have**
* 10\+ years of overall professional experience, with 5\+ years in pre\-sales, solutions engineering, or solution consulting roles at an enterprise software or SaaS company.
* Hands\-on experience with ITSM platforms including integration patterns, workflow design, and the broader technology landscape.
* Demonstrated experience working within a partner or channel motion: co\-selling alongside GSIs, regional SIs, VARs, or system integrators, and understanding how to win through partners rather than independently.
* Proven expertise with enterprise automation platforms \- Automation Anywhere, UiPath, Blue Prism, or equivalent including the ability to build and demonstrate production\-quality automations and agentic workflows.
* Fluency in the broader enterprise application ecosystem: SAP, Salesforce, Oracle, ServiceNow, Workday, and their integration within automation architectures.
* Working knowledge of agentic AI concepts: LLMs, RAG, prompt engineering, AI agent frameworks, and how they apply to enterprise automation use cases.
* Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field; advanced degrees and platform certifications (AA, UiPath, ServiceNow) are a plus.
* Ability to travel up to 40% to partner and customer sites


**You Excel in These Key Competencies**
* Partner\-first mindset: you make partners look good in front of their customers, building trust that drives long\-term co\-sell relationships.
* Equally fluent with C\-suite executives and hands\-on technical architects: You can shift register in the same meeting without losing credibility in either direction.
* Deep ITSM domain fluency that lets you speak the language of IT operations, service delivery, and enterprise IT transformation without relying on scripted demos.

50aa688d.title: Field Architect
50aa688d.description:
MinIO is the data and memory foundation for enterprise AI. Built for the speed, scale, and economics that AI and analytics demand, AIStor and MemKV unify every layer of the data stack, from agentic and inference context memory to tables and objects across core, edge, and cloud. Trusted by 77% of the Fortune 100, MinIO is redefining how AI factories, intelligent applications, and autonomous agents secure, persist, and unlock the full value of their data.
   

  

 The Field Architect role at MinIO is a senior customer\-facing technical leadership position focused on defining, validating, and guiding AIStor architectures for AI, analytics, cloud\-native applications, and large\-scale data infrastructure. You will serve as a trusted technical advisor to customers, partners, and internal teams, translating business and application requirements into robust technical designs that deliver measurable outcomes.
   

  

 You will collaborate closely with the broader MinIO team to ensure customers are successful through technical discovery, architecture design, proof\-of\-value execution, production onboarding, performance validation, and long\-term expansion. Success in this role requires deep technical curiosity, hands\-on architecture skills, strong communication, and the ability to connect AIStor’s capabilities to the data\-intensive workloads that matter most to our customers.
   

  

**What You Will Do**
 Technical Leadership \& Architecture
   

  

* Technical Architecture and Discovery: Lead technical discovery with customers and partners to understand their business goals, application requirements, data architecture, infrastructure constraints, and success criteria. Define scalable AIStor architectures that map directly to those requirements.
* AI and Analytics Workload Design: Define and validate AIStor architectures for AI/ML training and inference, analytics platforms, data lakehouse environments, high\-performance data pipelines, large object workloads, and modern application data services.
* Object Storage and S3 Expertise: Serve as a subject matter expert in object storage, S3\-compatible architectures, distributed systems, metadata, replication, erasure coding, security, performance tuning, and large\-scale namespace design.


 Customer Engagement \& Advisory
   

  

* Customer Technical Advisor: Build trusted relationships with customer technical stakeholders, including infrastructure, platform, analytics, AI, security, application, and operations teams. Guide customers toward informed architecture decisions and proactively identify opportunities to improve performance, resilience, scale, and operational efficiency.
* Proof\-of\-Value Execution: Lead technical evaluations, system configurations, performance testing, interoperability validation, and proof\-of\-value engagements that demonstrate AIStor’s value in real customer environments.
* Customer Success Beyond the Win: Partner with Customer Engineering, Product Management, and Engineering teams to help customers move from evaluation to production and from initial deployment to broader adoption across additional workloads, teams, and use cases.


 Ecosystem, Enablement \& Field Operations
   

  

* Cloud\-Native and Kubernetes Guidance: Provide technical leadership on Kubernetes, containers, automation, and cloud\-native deployment patterns, including hybrid cloud, private cloud, public cloud, and edge infrastructure models.
* Solution Integration and Ecosystem Collaboration: Work with technology partners, reseller partners, and customer teams to support complete solutions involving analytics engines, AI platforms, Kubernetes distributions, data protection tools, identity systems, observability platforms, and public cloud services.
* Technical Presentations and Enablement: Build and deliver compelling architecture presentations, whiteboard sessions, demonstrations, best practices, workshops, and technical enablement sessions for customers, partners, and internal teams.
* RFP, RFI, and Technical Response Support: Contribute to or lead technical portions of RFPs, RFIs, RFQs, security reviews, architecture questionnaires, and competitive evaluations.


 Product Intelligence \& Market Expertise
   

  

* Product and Engineering Feedback: Advocate for customer requirements internally by capturing field feedback, competitive insights, workload patterns, integration needs, and enhancement opportunities. Work with Product and Engineering teams to help inform roadmap priorities and improve customer outcomes.
* Competitive and Market Expertise: Stay current on object storage, data lakehouse, AI infrastructure, analytics, Kubernetes, cloud, and competitive storage trends. Help internal teams and customers understand where AIStor is differentiated.


**Your Skills And Experience**
* Strong background in enterprise storage, object storage, distributed systems, cloud infrastructure, data platforms, or high\-performance data\-intensive applications.
* Strong understanding of object storage concepts and S3\-compatible architectures; experience with HTTP, REST APIs, JSON, security models, replication, data protection, and scale\-out system design is highly valuable.
* 10\+ years of experience in a senior customer\-facing technical role such as Field Architect, Solutions Architect, Sales Engineer, Systems Engineer, or Technical Consultant.
* Hands\-on experience with Linux, networking, storage systems, virtualization, containers, Kubernetes, and modern data center infrastructure.
* Experience designing or supporting AI, machine learning, analytics, data lakehouse, or large\-scale data pipeline environments.
* Familiarity with ecosystem technologies such as Databricks, Starburst, Spark, Trino, Iceberg, Delta Lake, Kafka, PyTorch, TensorFlow, or other AI and analytics frameworks is a strong plus.
* Experience with public cloud and hybrid cloud environments, including AWS, Azure, GCP, OCI, or private cloud platforms.
* Ability to conduct technical discovery, design architectures, build demonstrations, guide proof\-of\-value execution, analyze performance, and communicate tradeoffs clearly.
* Comfortable working with heterogeneous enterprise environments involving compute, storage, networking, security, identity, observability, backup, disaster recovery, and application teams.
* Strong verbal, written, whiteboarding, and presentation skills, with the ability to communicate complex technical concepts to both technical and executive audiences.
* Ability to work collaboratively across customers, partners, Sales, Product, Engineering, and Customer Engineering teams.
* Strong customer\-success orientation, intellectual curiosity, sense of ownership, and ability to prioritize effectively in a fast\-moving environment.
* Willingness to travel as needed to support customers, partners, field events, and internal team activities.
* Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Information Systems, or a related technical field; equivalent practical experience will also be considered.


**Equal Opportunity Policy (EEO)**
 MinIO is proud to be an equal opportunity workplace and an affirmative action employer. We review applications for employment without regard to their race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, ancestry, citizenship, age, veteran status, genetic information, physical or mental disability, medical condition, marital status, or any other basis prohibited by law.

5c608db6.title: Senior Technical Program Manager (Engineering)
5c608db6.description:
**Who we are** 




  





 Mindtickle is the leading AI\-powered revenue enablement platform that combines on\-the\-job learning and deal execution to drive behavior change and get more revenue per rep. Mindtickle is recognized as a market leader by top industry analysts and is ranked by G2 as the \#1 sales onboarding and training product.
 



  





 Our commitment to innovation has also earned us the "AI\-based Sales Solution of the Year" award in the 8th annual AI Breakthrough Awards program (PR Newswire), and a Gold Stevie Award for Sales and Customer Service (Mindtickle)\- recognition of our dedication to both product excellence and outstanding customer support.
 



  





**Job snapshot** 




 Mindtickle is looking for an experienced, self\-driven, detail\-oriented Senior Technical Program Manager (TPM) for our Enterprise SaaS platform \- someone who thrives on solving complex engineering challenges, champions quality, and brings a collaborative style to cross\-functional teams, and and embraces modern execution practices in an AI\-enabled world that demands strategic alignment, systems thinking, sound judgment, trust building, and measurable business outcomes.
 



 You will lead complex, cross\-functional initiatives with high ambiguity and high stakes, delivering outcomes for enterprise and strategic customers. Constraints are real. Visibility is high. Customer commitments matter. Success will be shared widely; setbacks will be owned, learned from, and used to improve. If you thrive where the path is unclear and the outcome matters, this role is for you.
 



 In an AI\-enabled world, we need a TPM who combines technical acumen, systems thinking, and strong execution. You will eliminate roadblocks, proactively mitigate risks, align stakeholders, and drive delivery excellence while balancing speed with rigor, quality, scalability, reliability and operational excellence. You will also help establish repeatable mechanisms, operating rhythms, and execution frameworks that enable teams to deliver predictably at scale.
 



 Most importantly, you will play a critical role in delivering a world\-class customer experience. Customer outcomes should remain at the center of every roadmap decision, dependency, trade\-off, and delivery milestone. We are looking for someone who can advocate for the customer when priorities compete and consistently translate execution excellence into meaningful customer and business impact.
 



  





 If you are looking for certainty, this role will frustrate you. If you are looking for challenge, ownership, and the opportunity to influence meaningful outcomes at scale, we would love to talk.
 



**Role Expectations:** 



* This role is not about tracking work. It is about creating clarity, driving alignment, and making outcomes inevitable.
* Drive the delivery and execution of engineering roadmap (multiple medium to large\-scale, complex projects) by imbibing a strategic outlook from the outset and by partnering with engineering, product, design, quality engineering, DevOps and other cross\-functional teams.
* Leverage customer feedback, operational insights, and platform data to identify friction points and ensure engineering investments address the highest\-impact customer and business needs.
* Drive AI\-enabled execution by leveraging modern AI tools to accelerate planning, decision\-making, documentation, risk and dependency identification/mitigation, and program delivery while maintaining accountability for outcomes.
* Drive AI\-first program thinking by grounding decisions in metrics, facts, and structured narratives to ensure strategic alignment.
* Establish appropriate governance and review mechanisms for AI\-assisted development, ensuring quality, reliability, security, and compliance are not compromised in pursuit of speed.
* Drive alignment, influence decisions, and create momentum across teams and leaders without relying on formal authority.
* Influence executives, product and engineering leaders, and cross\-functional stakeholders through data, structured thinking, and clear narratives.
* Foster transparent communication around shared outcomes and customer expectations.
* Adapt program execution practices to AI development lifecycles where requirements, capabilities, and technical approaches can evolve rapidly as models, tools, and learnings mature.
* Ensure smooth execution of complex programs or programs with cross\-stream dependencies
* Facilitate technical discussions around architectural trade\-offs, scaling challenges, and system performance with the goal of unblocking teams.
* Build and institutionalize reusable frameworks and tools to enable predictable, repeatable execution in a fast\-paced, dynamic environment.
* Periodically drive the health of the systems, operational readiness, and Incident Response Management.
* Work closely with engineering leaders to define, implement, standardize and continuously evolve the practices.
* Foster a culture of agility, adaptability, resilience, speed, and continuous improvement ensuring good practices and light\-touch processes that accelerate from planning, execution to launch and successful landing.



**Requirements:** 



* Minimum
 **relevant** 
 experience in TPM role:
 **8\-10 years** 
 of experience preferably in an enterprise SaaS/Cloud architecture.
* Prior experience in engaging with enterprise customers is a plus.
* Experience building execution mechanisms that enable continuous learning, informed experimentation, and predictable delivery in AI\-enabled engineering organizations.
* Ability to navigate ambiguity, make informed decisions with incomplete information, and maintain execution momentum in rapidly evolving AI environments.
* Sound judgment, strong prioritization skills, and a bias for action.
* Past experience in establishing, driving operational excellence, productivity metrics and transformation.
* Beyond the strong foundational TPM skills, possesses technical awareness in:
* System Design and Architecture
* Distributed systems and microservices architecture
* API design principles (REST, GraphQL, gRPC)
* Performance, Scalability and Security
* Knowledge of Authentication vs Authorization, and Enterprise Integrations
* SSO protocols (SAML, OAuth 2\.0, OpenID Connect)
* Identity \& Access Management (IAM) frameworks
* Multi\-Factor Authentication (MFA) \& Role\-Based Access Control (RBAC)
* Just\-in\-time (JIT) provisioning and SCIM (System for Cross\-domain Identity Management)
* Observability and Monitoring:
* Exposure to APM tools like Datadog.
* Good to have:
* Background in startups or 0\-1 programs.



**Key Skills** 



* Exceptional written and verbal communication skills, structured thinking, including the ability to create decision\-ready narratives for technical and executive audiences.
* Structured problem solver who breaks down complex challenges into logical, actionable components.
* Strong product, customer, and business mindset with a clear understanding of the "why" behind initiatives.
* Exceptional stakeholder management and influence skills, with the ability to drive alignment without formal authority.
* Sound judgment, prioritization, and decision\-making skills in ambiguous and fast\-changing environments.
* Systems thinker who can connect strategy, execution, operational excellence, and customer outcomes.
* Proficient in leveraging AI tools (claude/cursor etc) and LLM based solutions to enhance program efficiency, surface actionable insights, automation, and team productivity.



**What success looks like** 



* Programs ship predictably with quality, delivering measurable customer and business outcomes.
* Operational excellence improves through stronger execution mechanisms, predictable delivery, and continuous improvement.
* Teams stay focused; stakeholders stay informed; decisions stay documented.
* Surprises are rare because risks and dependencies are identified and addressed early.
* Execution becomes more predictable, scalable, and repeatable.
* In moments of uncertainty, you are the calm center in the storm.



**The reality** 



* High ambiguity and evolving priorities.
* Customers experience the outcome, not internal complexity.
* Customer outcomes and commitments remain the north star, even when priorities compete.
* Balancing customer needs, business objectives, and engineering realities requires sound judgment and thoughtful trade\-offs.
* Complex cross\-functional dependencies and accountability without always having authority.



**Why this team** 



* Executive support, strong product and senior engineering partners.
* Culture that values candor, ownership, and outcomes over theatrics.

6dd3463b.title: Demo Engineer / Presales Solutions Consulting
6dd3463b.description:
Here at Appian, our values of
 **Intensity** 
 and
 **Excellence** 
 define who we are. We set high standards and live up to them, ensuring that everything we do is done with care and quality. We approach every challenge with ambition and commitment, holding ourselves and each other accountable to achieve the best results. When you join Appian, you’ll be part of a passionate team dedicated to accomplishing hard things, together.
 



  
 


**Demo Engineer** 

 Here at Appian, our core values of Excellence and Intensity define who we are. In short, this means we constantly seek to understand the best for our customers, we go beyond completion in our work, we strive for excellence with intensity, and we embrace candid communication. These values guide our actions and shape our culture every day. When you join Appian, you'll be part of a passionate team that's dedicated to accomplishing hard things.
 



  
 




 SC 2\.0 is the engine powering our vision
 
 . Appian's
 **Sales Solutions Consulting** 
 team is in the midst of an exciting transformation \-\- redefining what it means to be a trusted advisor in today's fast\-paced, mission\-driven environment. Our SCs don't just demo features \-\- they tell stories, co\-create with customers, and help shape strategy with technical credibility and business insight.
 
 Read More About SC 2\.0 Here
 




  
 



 You can listen to our Global SSC leader, Gregg Aldana discuss SC 2\.0
 
 here
 
 .
 



  
 



 The
 **SPEAR Team** 
 (Strategic Presales Execution and Readiness) is the operational engine behind Appian's global Presales organization \-\- the team that builds the tools, assets, governance, and infrastructure that let Solutions Consultants do their best work. As a Demo Engineer on SPEAR, you are not on the sidelines of SC 2\.0 \-\- you are one of the people making it possible at scale.
 



  
 



**The Role** 




  
 



 Behind every great demo is a great demo asset, and that's where you come in. As a Demo Engineer on Appian's SPEAR Team in Chennai, you are the technical backbone that turns one\-off sales demos into a polished, reusable, continuously evolving library that powers hundreds of sales engagements each year. While our Solutions Consultants are out in the field telling stories and co\-creating with customers, you ensure they always have the right asset, in the right shape, ready to go.
 



  
 



 In this role, you'll capture, refine, and expand Appian product demos \-\- de\-branding prospect\-specific work, modernizing older assets with the latest platform capabilities, and packaging everything into reusable demos, clickable demo experiences, walkthrough videos, and scripts. You'll also contribute directly to DemoHub, Appian's centralized demo catalog and governance system \-\- helping evolve the application itself, not just the content inside it.
 



  
 



 You will be coached and guided by the Lead Demo Engineer based in Chennai, reporting to the SPEAR Team leadership in the US \-\- giving you both strong local support and direct visibility into Appian's global Presales strategy.
 



  
 



 This is a unique opportunity to develop deep expertise in the Appian platform while making a tangible, measurable impact on global sales. If you're detail\-oriented, technically curious, and excited about shaping how Appian shows up to the market, this role is for you.
 



  
 



 What you'll be doing...
 


* Demo Ingestion and Cataloging: Capture product demos developed during live sales engagements and ingest them into DemoHub, ensuring they are organized, tagged, discoverable, and reusable across the global Solutions Consulting organization.
* De\-branding and Refinement: De\-brand prospect\-specific demos, clean up their design and functionality, and prepare them for broader organizational use \-\- turning one\-off assets into reusable gold.
* Demo Enhancement: Refresh and extend existing demos by incorporating advanced new Appian features and functionality, keeping the library current with the latest product releases, GTM narratives, and industry trends.
* DemoHub Application Development: Contribute to the ongoing development and maintenance of the DemoHub Appian application itself \-\- the platform that stores, governs, and surfaces demo content to the global SC team. This includes building new features, fixing bugs, and improving usability.
* Clickable Demo Production: Record, edit, and continually update interactive clickable demos in a commercial third\-party demo platform, ensuring our self\-service and accelerated demo experiences stay accurate, on\-brand, and aligned with current product capabilities.
* Demo Artifact Creation: Produce supporting artifacts including walkthrough videos, demo scripts, talk tracks, and quick\-reference guides that help SCs adopt and adapt assets quickly.
* Cross\-functional Collaboration: Partner with Solutions Consultants worldwide, the SPEAR Team, and other Presales stakeholders to ensure demo assets reflect the latest go\-to\-market priorities and customer outcomes.
* Continuous Improvement: Identify opportunities to streamline demo ingestion, cataloging, and maintenance workflows, and help bring those ideas to life.
* Additional SPEAR Initiatives: Contribute to other Presales enablement and readiness initiatives as the SPEAR Team's portfolio evolves.



  
 



 Who you are...
 


* Strong experience with Appian or a similar low\-code application development platform, including design, development, and debugging of applications.
* Excellent technical and programming skills are a must, with concrete examples of times you have applied them to deliver polished work.
* Attention to detail and a focus on delivering high\-quality output \-\- the kind that other people see and immediately want to copy.
* Excellent organizational skills and the ability to prioritize tasks in a high\-volume, dynamic environment (think hundreds of demos per year flowing through your pipeline).
* Comfortable working on a cross\-functional team and collaborating with global stakeholders across multiple time zones. Solid verbal, written, presentation, and interpersonal communication skills are a must.
* Familiarity with interactive demo platforms (Storylane, Reprise, Navattic, Walnut, or similar) is a strong plus.
* Familiarity with video recording and editing tools for producing walkthrough content is a plus.
* Self\-motivated, highly driven individual with a strong sense of urgency.
* B.S. or M.S. in Engineering, Computer Science, Economics, Math, Physics, or equivalent work experience.



  
 



  
 




**Tools and Resources** 




* Training and Development: During onboarding, we focus on equipping new hires with the skills and knowledge for success through department\-specific training. Continuous learning is a central focus at Appian, with dedicated mentorship and the First\-Friend program being widely utilized resources for new hires.
* Growth Opportunities: Appian provides a diverse array of growth and development opportunities, including our leadership program tailored for new and aspiring managers, a comprehensive library of specialized department training through Appian University, skills based training, and tuition reimbursement for those aiming to advance their education. This commitment ensures that employees have access to a holistic range of development opportunities.
* Community: We’ll immerse you into our community rooted in respect starting on day one. Appian fosters inclusivity through our 8 employee\-led affinity groups. These groups help employees build stronger internal and external networks by planning social, educational, and outreach activities to connect with Appianites and larger initiatives throughout the company.



**Benefits**




 Appian offers a comprehensive benefits package designed to support your health, wellbeing, and financial future. Benefits may include health coverage, Employee Assistance Program (EAP) with free mental health support, life and disability insurance, an Employee Stock Purchase Program (ESPP), a retirement/pension plan, wellness dollars, tuition reimbursement, family\-forming benefits and more. Benefits vary by country—please ask your Talent Acquisition contact for details specific to the location you are applying to.
 




**About Appian** 





 Appian provides AI automation for mission\-critical work. We automate complex processes in large enterprises and governments. Our platform is known for its unique reliability and scale. We’ve been automating processes for more than 25 years and understand enterprise operations like no one else. For more information, visit appian.com. \[Nasdaq: APPN]
 



 Follow Appian: LinkedIn, Youtube, Instagram, Facebook

*Appian provides reasonable accommodations to applicants in accordance with all applicable laws. If you need a reasonable accommodation for any part of the employment process, please contact us by email at ReasonableAccommodations@appian.com. 265ff11b.description:
**Location:**

Bengaluru, Karnataka, India
**Job ID:**

R0137676

**Company Name:**

HITACHI ENERGY TECHNOLOGY SERVICES PRIVATE LIMITED

IT, Telecom \& Internet
**Job Schedule:**

Full time
**Remote:**

No
**Job Description:**

**The opportunity**

At Hitachi Energy, we are accelerating our digital transformation journey by optimizing and modernizing global transportation and logistics operations. As a SAP TM Solution Architect, you will play a critical role in defining, designing, implementing, and supporting enterprise\-wide transportation management solutions that enable efficient, scalable, and intelligent logistics processes across our global business landscape.


In this role, you will combine transportation management expertise, solution architecture leadership, and emerging technologies such as SAP Business Technology Platform (BTP) and Artificial Intelligence (AI) to drive innovation and operational excellence. You will lead SAP TM transformation initiatives, define strategic roadmaps, and deliver robust, integrated logistics solutions aligned with business objectives and enterprise architecture standards.


**How you'll make an impact**

* Define and govern the SAP TM solution architecture strategy, standards, and roadmap across global business functions.
* Design scalable, standardized, and best\-practice transportation management processes that support global logistics operations.
* Ensure solution alignment with enterprise architecture principles, cybersecurity requirements, compliance regulations, and digital transformation objectives.
* Lead architecture reviews, solution governance forums, and technical decision\-making processes.
* Design and optimize SAP TM capabilities including Freight Unit Building, Transportation Planning, Load Planning and Optimization, Carrier Selection, Freight Order Management, Transportation Execution, Freight Settlement, Cost Allocation, Charge Management, Logistics Visibility, and Event Tracking.
* Drive global standardization and harmonization of transportation management processes and solutions.
* Provide technical leadership for SAP TM solution development and architecture.
* Review and approve technical designs, enhancements, custom developments, and solution integrations.
* Deliver expertise in ABAP OO, BOPF Framework, FPM Applications, CDS Views, OData Services, APIs, Enhancement Framework, Workflow, and BRF\+.
* Architect SAP BTP\-based extensions, integrations, and cloud\-native transportation management solutions.
* Evaluate and implement innovative technologies and digital capabilities that improve transportation planning, visibility, and execution.
* Enable event\-driven and API\-based architectures to support modern business processes and integrations.
* Define and lead AI\-enabled transportation optimization strategies.
* Evaluate AI and machine learning use cases including route optimization, shipment consolidation, predictive freight planning, load planning optimization, transportation exception management, and logistics cost optimization.
* Support the integration of AI services within SAP solutions and external platforms.
* Lead adoption and integration of SAP Business Network for Logistics (BN4L), including carrier collaboration, freight tendering, shipment tracking, and logistics visibility capabilities.
* Strengthen collaboration with carriers, freight forwarders, logistics providers, and external business partners.
* Define end\-to\-end integration architecture between SAP TM and connected systems, including SAP S/4HANA, SAP EWM, SAP GTS, SAP BTP, BN4L, third\-party logistics providers, and external carrier platforms.
* Ensure reliable, scalable, and secure integrations using APIs, IDocs, events, middleware technologies, and SAP Integration Suite.
* Act as the senior escalation point for critical SAP TM issues and support complex incident resolution activities.
* Conduct root cause analysis, provide solution recommendations, and drive continuous improvement initiatives.
* Mentor and guide functional consultants, developers, and project teams to build organizational capability and best practices.

**Your background**

* Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Engineering, Supply Chain Management, or a related discipline.
* Minimum 10 years of SAP experience, with at least 7 years of hands\-on expertise in SAP Transportation Management (SAP TM).
* Proven experience as an SAP TM Solution Architect within complex global organizations.
* Strong expertise in transportation management, logistics operations, freight management, and supply chain processes.
* Experience delivering global SAP implementation, transformation, and rollout programs.
* Deep knowledge of SAP Transportation Management (SAP TM) and SAP S/4HANA TM.
* Experience with SAP Business Network for Logistics (BN4L), SAP BTP, SAP EWM, and SAP GTS.
* Strong technical architecture knowledge covering ABAP OO, BOPF, FPM, CDS Views, OData Services, APIs, BRF\+, Enhancement Framework, and SAP Integration Suite.
* Experience with RAP (RESTful Application Programming Model) is preferred.
* Strong understanding of cloud\-based architectures, integration patterns, and event\-driven solutions.
* Familiarity with AI and machine learning applications in transportation and logistics domains is highly desirable.
* Excellent stakeholder management, communication, leadership, and problem\-solving skills.
* Demonstrates effective use of AI and digital tools to enhance problem\-solving, decision\-making, and productivity, while applying sound judgment, ensuring accuracy and compliance, and maintaining accountability for outcomes.
* Ability to work effectively in a global, cross\-functional, and multicultural environment.
**Accessibility and reasonable accommodation**

**Qualified individuals with a disability may request a reasonable accommodation if you are unable or limited in your ability to use or access the Hitachi Energy career site as a result of your disability. You may request reasonable accommodations by completing a** **general inquiry form** **on our website. These tools are designed to support our recruiters and do not replace human decision\-making. These may include, but are not limited to, enhanced criminal history checks, credit history reviews (where legally permissible), sanctions screening, or other due diligence measures aligned with the responsibilities of the position.**

4b8e88ab.title: Lead Managed Services Consultant
4b8e88ab.description:
Sprinklr is the definitive, AI\-native platform for Unified Customer Experience Management (Unified\-CXM), empowering brands to deliver extraordinary experiences at scale — across every customer touchpoint.
   

  

 By combining human instinct with the speed and efficiency of AI, Sprinklr helps brands earn trust and loyalty through personalized, seamless, and efficient customer interactions. Sprinklr’s unified platform provides powerful solutions for every customer\-facing team — spanning social media management, marketing, advertising, customer feedback, and omnichannel contact center management — enabling enterprises to unify data, break down silos, and act on real\-time insights.
   

  

 Today, 1,900\+ enterprises and 60% of the Fortune 100 rely on Sprinklr to help them deliver consistent, trusted customer experiences worldwide.
   

  

**Job Description**
**Role Summary**
 Lead managed services delivery for Sprinklr Community customers by owning the strategy, architecture, governance, and evolution of customer community platforms. Drive community transformation initiatives, user experience optimization, platform adoption, and operational excellence while serving as the primary advisor to customers on community best practices, digital engagement, and platform roadmap execution.
   

  

**What You’ll Do**
* Lead end\-to\-end management and optimization of Sprinklr Community platforms, ensuring scalability, performance, governance, and business alignment.
* Design and oversee community architecture including forums, discussion boards, knowledge communities, user journeys, moderation frameworks, gamification, and engagement models.
* Act as the primary strategic advisor for customer community initiatives, providing recommendations on platform adoption, engagement growth, governance, and operational maturity.
* Drive requirements discovery, solution design, roadmap planning, and execution of community enhancement programs.
* Define and implement community governance frameworks including roles, permissions, moderation strategies, content lifecycle management, and user access controls.
* Lead root cause analysis and resolution of complex platform, workflow, configuration, and user experience issues.
* Own community analytics, adoption reporting, engagement insights, and continuous improvement initiatives.
* Provide leadership and guidance to consultants and technical teams supporting community operations and managed services delivery.
* Partner with Customer Success, Product, Engineering, and customer leadership teams to ensure successful outcomes and long\-term platform value realization.
* Lead release management, platform audits, health checks, optimization reviews, and best practice assessments.
* Oversee UI/UX strategy and front\-end customization initiatives to deliver intuitive, accessible, and engaging community experiences.
* Provide architectural guidance on API integrations, SSO, CRM connectivity, and third\-party ecosystem integrations.
* Establish reusable governance models, operational playbooks, implementation standards, and community best practices.


**What Makes You Qualified?**
**Must Have Qualifications**
* 8\-12 years of experience in Community Platforms, Digital Experience Platforms, Managed Services, SaaS Consulting, or Customer Engagement solutions.
* Deep hands\-on experience with Sprinklr Community or similar platforms such as Khoros, Gainsight, Salesforce Experience Cloud, Higher Logic, or Enterprise Community solutions.
* Proven experience designing, building, launching, and managing large\-scale customer community portals and online forums.
* Strong expertise in community architecture, moderation frameworks, engagement strategies, governance models, and digital customer experiences.
* Advanced knowledge of UI/UX principles, information architecture, user journey design, accessibility, and community experience optimization.
* Strong understanding of HTML, CSS, JavaScript, responsive design principles, and front\-end customization approaches.
* High\-level understanding of REST APIs, authentication models, SSO, webhooks, integrations, and enterprise system connectivity.
* Experience leading customer workshops, solution design sessions, governance reviews, and executive stakeholder discussions.
* Strong analytical, problem\-solving, consulting, and customer management capabilities.


**Good To Have Skills**
* Experience with customer support communities, brand advocacy programs, knowledge communities, or peer\-to\-peer support ecosystems.
* Exposure to SEO, search optimization, content strategy, and digital engagement best practices.
* Understanding of CRM platforms, customer support ecosystems, and customer experience technologies.

cf02f278.title: Sr. Solutions Architect/Senior Enterprise Integration Architect - Finance Systems
cf02f278.description:
**COMPANY OVERVIEW**



At Zuora, we do Modern Business. We're helping people subscribe to new ways of doing business that are better for people, companies and ultimately the planet. It's an approach resulting from the shift to the Subscription Economy that puts customers first by building recurring relationships instead of one\-time product sales and focuses on sustainable growth. Through our leading expertise and multi\-product suite, we are transforming all industries and working with the world's most innovative companies to monetize new business models, nurture subscriber relationships and optimize their digital experiences.


**THE TEAM \& ROLE**



Zuora's Corporate Operations organization serves as the backbone of our internal technology ecosystem, building digital experiences that connect teams, align business priorities, and strengthen collaboration company\-wide. Taking a cloud\-first, AI\-enabled approach, we empower our global ZEOs with modern tools and self\-service solutions that drive productivity, scalability, and agility \- all while upholding the highest standards of security and compliance.



Within Corporate Operations, the G\&A Business Applications team designs, implements, and optimizes the systems that power all of Zuora's core General \& Administrative functions, including Finance, FP\&A, Procurement, ZEO Success (HR), and Legal. Reporting to the Senior Business Systems Manager of Digital Workplace Experience, this team works closely with system analysts, administrators, project managers, data architects, and developers to deliver robust, scalable business solutions.



The Sr, Solutions Architect \- Finance Systems is a senior technical expert and data architect responsible for designing, building, and securing enterprise\-grade data structures and integrations across our corporate systems ecosystem. This role functions as a critical cross\-functional data and system integration specialist, ensuring seamless data flow, robust security governance, and scalable automation across diverse business platforms (e.g., Coupa, Workday, NetSuite, Navan, Lattice, Greenhouse, and more).



You'll join a collaborative, high\-performing team that values innovation, continuous improvement, and professional growth. Your work will directly impact the efficiency, quality, and scalability of Zuora's enterprise systems and digital transformation initiatives.


**YOUR MISSION**



As a senior technical anchor supporting all G\&A functions, the Sr, Solutions Architect \- Finance Systems collaborates closely with leaders across Finance, FP\&A, Procurement, ZEO Success, and Legal to establish a cohesive enterprise data architecture. You will build robust system integrations and leverage cutting\-edge AI frameworks to drive efficiency, maximize data reliability, and enforce strict compliance across all internal platforms in alignment with strategic goals.


**YOUR OPPORTUNITY**



As the Sr, Solutions Architect \- Finance Systems, you will play a vital role in the development, data architecture, and integration of Finance, FP\&A, Procurement, ZEO Success, and Legal systems. Combining your expertise as a data architect and multi\-platform integration specialist, you'll ensure seamless data flow, scalable automation, and cross\-system reliability without being tied to a single core vendor. You'll work closely with functional BSAs to prioritize initiatives, refine user stories, and deliver enhancements through agile sprints, while supporting testing and deployment activities.



Key responsibilities include:


* Lead integration support and comprehensive data architecture across core Finance, FP\&A, Procurement, ZEO Success, and Legal business systems, ensuring cross\-platform data consistency and process efficiency.
* Define and maintain end\-to\-end data models, data lineage, and integration patterns across all G\&A applications, establishing a unified "single source of truth" bridging corporate finance, workforce analytics, and legal operations.
* Design, build, and optimize secure, high\-performing API\-based integrations, microservices, and file\-based data flows (REST API, Webhooks, OAuth 2\.0, SQL) across Coupa, Workday, NetSuite, Navan, Lattice, Greenhouse, and more tools.
* Architect and implement AI\-driven automation workflows; evaluate and integrate AI productivity tools and emerging standard frameworks—such as Model Context Protocol (MCP) servers—to safely expose internal tools and secure data layers to AI agents.
* Enforce strict data security policies, field\-level encryption, masking, and access controls across integrated systems to protect sensitive workforce metrics (ZEO Success/PII), legal records, and financial data.
* Collaborate with cross\-functional BSAs, business cross functional teams, and security teams using RACI frameworks to clearly map out data ownership, system accountability, and technical execution roles across different departments.
* Ensure configuration standards, technical architecture diagrams, and SOPs are up to date and fully compliant with internal controls, SOX, and global privacy standards (GDPR/CCPA).


**OUR TECH STACK:** REST API, Webhooks, OAuth 2\.0, SQL, JavaScript/Python, Coupa, Workday, NetSuite, Navan, Lattice, Greenhouse, AI Automation Tools, and MCP Server frameworks.

  


### **WHAT YOU'LL ACCOMPLISH**


* **Deliver Modern Data Architecture**: Transition fragmented cross\-system data points from disparate G\&A tools into a beautifully mapped out, resilient, and highly secure enterprise data model.
* **Excellence in System Integrations**: Establish scalable, automated data connections that allow Finance, FP\&A, Procurement, HR, and Legal tools to communicate without operational friction, keeping sync latencies low and reliability high.
* **Next\-Gen Tech Adoption:** Successfully implement secure AI extensions or MCP servers to optimize everyday business workflows and scale manual reporting processes down to self\-service models.
* **Advance Automation \& Data Reliability:** Develop solutions that strengthen data accuracy, eliminate manual tasks, reduce operational overhead, and increase system reliability across end\-to\-end business workflows.
* **Promote Secure \& Compliant Operations:** Collaborate with IT, Security, and Audit teams to uphold field\-level data protection, access controls, and strict compliance (SOX/GDPR) across all integration data layers.
* **Establish Sustainable System Practices**: Maintain clear documentation, SOPs, and configuration standards to ensure long\-term scalability and consistent cross\-functional operational excellence.


**WHAT YOU'LL NEED TO BE SUCCESSFUL**


* Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Systems, Data Architecture, or a related technical field (or equivalent practical experience).
* 8\+ years of experience in system integrations and backend development (Proficient in REST APIs, SQL, JavaScript/Python, OAuth, and web services).
* Deep hands\-on exposure to data structures and integration patterns within modern G\&A systems—specifically covering tools across Procurement (Coupa), HR/ATS (Workday, Lattice, Greenhouse), and ERP/Expense (NetSuite, Navan).
* Proven understanding of LLM application patterns, AI integration tools, and modular protocol concepts like Model Context Protocol (MCP).
* Solid understanding of data security standards, encryption practices, access control models, and IT/SOX compliance frameworks required when handling sensitive employee, financial, and legal records.
* Strong familiarity with project governance frameworks, including using RACI matrices to clarify cross\-team responsibilities.
* Exceptional cross\-functional collaboration and communication skills; the ability to elegantly translate complex technical and data architecture blueprints to functional business partners across completely different business disciplines.


**\#ZEOLife at Zuora**



As an industry pioneer, our work is constantly evolving and challenging us in new ways that require us to think differently, iterate often and learn constantly—it's exciting. Our people, whom we refer to as "ZEOs" are empowered to take on a mindset of ownership and make a bigger impact here. Our teams collaborate deeply, exchange different ideas openly and together we're making what's next possible for our customers, community and the world.



As part of our commitment to building an inclusive, high\-performance culture where ZEOs feel inspired, connected and valued, we support ZEOs with:



Competitive compensation, corporate bonus program and performance rewards, company equity and retirement programs



Medical, dental and vision insurance



Generous, flexible time off



Paid holidays, "wellness" days and company wide end of year break



Learning \& Development stipend



Opportunities to volunteer and give back, including charitable donation match



Free resources and support for your mental wellbeing


* Specific benefits offerings may vary by country and can be viewed in more detail during your interview process.



Location \& Work Arrangements



Organizations and teams at Zuora are empowered to design efficient and flexible ways of working, being intentional about scheduling, communication, and collaboration strategies that help us achieve our best results. In our dynamic, globally distributed company, this means balancing flexibility and responsibility — flexibility to live our lives to the fullest, and responsibility to each other, to our customers, and to our shareholders. For most roles, we offer the flexibility to work both remotely and at Zuora offices.



Our Commitment to an Inclusive Workplace



Think, be and do you! At Zuora, different perspectives, experiences and contributions matter. Everyone counts. Zuora is proud to be an Equal Opportunity Employer committed to creating an inclusive environment for all.



Zuora does not discriminate on the basis of, and considers individuals seeking employment with Zuora without regards to, race, religion, color, national origin, sex (including pregnancy, childbirth, reproductive health decisions, or related medical conditions), sexual orientation, gender identity, gender expression, age, status as a protected veteran, status as an individual with a disability, genetic information, political views or activity, or other applicable legally protected characteristics.



We encourage candidates from all backgrounds to apply. Applicants in need of special assistance or accommodation during the interview process or in accessing our website may contact us by sending an email to assistance@zuora.com.

7b883555.title: Senior Staff Architect SAP S/4 Analytics
7b883555.description:
What if the work you did every day could impact the lives of people you know? Or all of humanity?
At Illumina, we are expanding access to genomic technology to realize health equity for billions of people around the world. Our efforts enable life\-changing discoveries that are transforming human health through the early detection and diagnosis of diseases and new treatment options for patients.
Working at Illumina means being part of something bigger than yourself. Every person, in every role, has the opportunity to make a difference. Surrounded by extraordinary people, inspiring leaders, and world changing projects, you will do more and become more than you ever thought possible.
**Senior Staff SAP S/4 Analytics Architect**
============================================

**Position Summary**
--------------------

We are seeking an experienced Senior Staff SAP S/4 Analytics Architect to establish and scale our SAP S/4 Embedded Analytics capability. This **hands\-on architecture** role defines the platform, governance, and delivery standards that enable secure, scalable, high\-quality operational analytics aligned with SAP Clean Core principles.
  

  

Starting as the primary report developer, the architect will build the foundation for success by creating reusable Virtual Data Models (VDMs), CDS standards, reference implementations, governance processes, architecture reviews, transport and release controls, security standards, and development best practices.
  

  

The role will establish and enable the SAP Embedded Analytics Expert capability through mentoring, reusable assets, templates, and technical guidance. By leading through hands\-on implementation and reference solutions, the architect will enable a guided self\-service analytics model that accelerates report delivery while maintaining architectural guardrails, governance, and solution quality.
  

  

The architect will also modernize legacy reporting by driving the transition from SQ01 and custom reports to SAP S/4 Embedded Analytics using standard SAP Fiori analytical applications, CDS Views, and reusable analytical models. Success will be measured by a sustainable analytics platform, strong governance, faster report delivery, and an empowered Analytics Expert community.


**Key Responsibilities**
------------------------

* Support the SAP S/4 Embedded Analytics architecture, roadmap, standards, and governance.
* Lead modernization of SQ01 and legacy reporting.
* Design reusable CDS Views, VDMs, Analytical Queries, KPIs, and Fiori analytical applications.
* Develop reusable templates, accelerators, and reference implementations.
* Establish architecture reviews, code reviews, testing, transport, security, and release governance.
* Build and mentor the SAP Embedded Analytics Expert community and establish an Analytics Center of Excellence.
* Enable guided self\-service analytics while ensuring SAP Clean Core compliance.
* Partner with business process owners across major SAP domains.

**Required Qualifications**
---------------------------

* 10\+ years of SAP analytics experience with multiple SAP S/4HANA implementations.
* Proven hands\-on implementation of SAP S/4 Embedded Analytics in at least one end\-to\-end SAP S/4 transformation.
* Expertise in ABAP CDS Views, VDMs, CDS Extensions, Analytical Queries and Fiori analytical applications
* Experience implementing analytics governance, architecture reviews, transport management, and operating models.
* Experience activating standard SAP analytics, replacing SQ01, and building reusable frameworks and Centers of Excellence.
* Strong end\-to\-end SAP business process knowledge and excellent stakeholder management.

**First 12 Months – Expected Outcomes**
---------------------------------------

* Establish governance, standards, templates, and reference architectures.
* Launch the SAP Embedded Analytics Expert enablement program.
* Deliver reusable CDS assets
* Implement review, transport, and quality processes.
* Enable the first wave of guided self\-service analytics.

**Success Measures**
--------------------

* Enterprise adoption of SAP S/4 Embedded Analytics.
* Retire SQ01 and reduce custom reporting.
* Faster report delivery through guided self\-service analytics.
* High reuse of standard SAP content and CDS assets.
Consistent governance and a self\-sustaining Analytics Expert community.

602e2d76.title: Solutions Architect - Brokerage Services
602e2d76.description:
Your opportunity
   

  

 At Charles Schwab, our purpose is simple: we champion client’s goals with passion and integrity. Guided by honesty, mutual respect and a commitment to doing what’s right, we bring innovation, education, and service together to help shape financial futures. Our people are the foundation of our success – they approach their work with curiosity and collaboration, coming together to create solutions that make a meaningful impact for clients and communities. As we expand into India, we are bringing this same culture of inclusion, learning, and opportunity to new talent. Joining us means becoming part of a global team where your work matters and your future can take shape.
   

  

 Our Hyderabad location is central to Schwab’s growth, bringing together talented people and technology to drive innovation, scale and efficiency. Here, you will work alongside teams who create solutions that support millions of clients every day. The work you do is more than daily operations – it’s a chance to experiment, learn, and build within a values\-driven, supportive environment. This is a unique opportunity to be part of our early growth phase and shape something new, backed by the stability and strength of a Fortune 500 company. Your impact begins on day one, and your contributions will help define our future in the region.
   

  

 Core Brokerage Services Engineering (CBSE) enables Schwab to fulfill its custodial and clearing obligations as a Broker\-Dealer and enables clients to invest strategically and achieve their financial goals. The Solutions Architect is a key technical leader in the CBSE organization, ensuring that Schwab India software development and engineering teams coalesce with established and evolving technology governance, standards, practices, and strategy as well as regulatory standards and requirements. This role requires a strong background in leading end\-to\-end architecture direction for high\-volume heterogenous technology platforms as well as hands\-on experience throughout the software development lifecycle. It’s an exciting time to join CBSE as it endeavors to modernize its platforms while incrementally delivering new features and capabilities to Schwab’s clients and growing businesses.
   

  

 Key Responsibilities
   

  

* Collaborate with peer platform architects, enterprise architects, and software development and engineering teams to develop and maintain cohesive current and target state software architecture documents and reference implementations.
* Balance long\-term thinking with crafting architecture increments that deliver business value near\-term, guiding technical leads in creating these designs.
* Mentor software developers and engineers to leverage established patterns and software engineering best practices and adhere to policies and standards.
* Champion end\-to\-end observability, monitoring and alerting, adherence to service level indicators and objectives, and operational excellence (24x7 availability).
* Identify and address scalability, latency, resiliency, and performance improvement opportunities.
* Lead architecture strategy sessions and engage hands\-on throughout the software delivery lifecycle to resolve challenges.
* Remain informed on industry trends in financial technology and apply this knowledge to drive innovation within the organization.


 What you have
   

  

**Required Qualifications**
* Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, or related field.
* 15\+ years of hands\-on full stack software development experience across diverse technologies such as .NET/C\#, Java/Spring framework, COBOL, Python, RabbitMQ/Kafka/IBM MQ, SOAP/REST services, and modern front\-end frameworks like Angular/React.
* Knowledge of both SQL (e.g., SQL Server, PostgreSQL, Cloud SQL, DB2\) and NoSQL databases (e.g., MongoDB, Aerospike) with extensive experience in designing and optimizing data solutions.
* 5\+ years hands\-on expertise architecting, designing and integrating components, and implementing large\-scale solutions
* Experience architecting and building private and public cloud\-based or cloud\-ready applications (e.g., PCF, GCP).
* Proven ability to handle fast\-paced agile delivery environment, prioritize competing deadlines, and contribute to multiple initiatives simultaneously.
* Excellent verbal and written communication skills, demonstrable ability to help others visualize application design and system integration patterns.
* Demonstratable proficiency in business analysis, problem\-solving, critical thinking, and troubleshooting skills.


**Preferred Qualifications**
* Experience in the financial services industry.
* Proven ability to build interpersonal relationships with various roles and garner fellowship.
* Ability to quickly grasp complex concepts and learn new technologies.
* Experience with AI and LLMs (e.g., GitHub Copilot, Microsoft Copilot).
* Working proficiency with software configuration management and continuous integration and delivery concepts and tools (e.g., Remedy, ChangeMan, GitHub, GitHub Actions, Bamboo, Jenkins).
* Experience supporting production operations and providing Site Reliability Engineering (SRE) expertise.
* Strong client focus and sense of ownership.


 What’s in it for you
   

  

 At Schwab India, you’re empowered to shape your future. We support your growth through meaningful work, continuous learning, and a culture rooted in trust and collaboration – so you can build the skills to make a lasting impact. Our benefits are designed to care for your wellbeing, your family, and your long\-term financial security.
   

  

**Our Base Benefits, Wellbeing, And Total Rewards Include**
* Competitive compensation and retirement programs including Employee Provident Fund (EPF), Gratuity, and optional National Pension System (NPS) contributions
* Robust Paid Time Off, including annual/privilege leave, sick and casual leave, public holidays, maternity/paternity leave, and more
* Education assistance for continued learning to help you grow
* Comprehensive medical insurance with Outpatient Department (OPD) services, including vaccination, pharmacy, dental, and vision coverage
* Annual reimbursement for health check\-ups and mental health support through our Employee Assistance Program (EAP)
* Childcare (creche) reimbursement for eligible employees
* Transportation and meal benefits that support your day\-to\-day work
* Group life, personal accident, and critical illness insurance

Responsible for leading the development of comprehensive solution architecture strategies, ensuring seamless integration of application solutions across teams and domains while maintaining robust technical foundations. The role involves collaboration with other architects to validate feasibility, oversee compliance with quality attributes, manage technical risks, and guide IT architects to enhance their solution architecture leadership skills, all while aligning with FedEx best practices and technological standards.
   

  

* Lead and define solution architecture strategies, encompassing technology and architecture for seamless integration of application solutions across various teams and domains.

* Project Management


**Preferred Qualifications**
**Pay Transparency:**
**Pay**
**Additional Details:**
 FedEx was built on a philosophy that puts people first, one we take seriously. We are an equal opportunity/affirmative action employer and we are committed to a diverse, equitable, and inclusive workforce in which we enforce fair treatment, and provide growth opportunities for everyone.
   

  

 All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment regardless of age, race, color, national origin, genetics, religion, gender, marital status, pregnancy (including childbirth or a related medical condition), physical or mental disability, or any other characteristic protected by applicable laws, regulations, and ordinances.
   

  

 Our Company
   

  

 FedEx is one of the world's largest express transportation companies and has consistently been selected as one of the top 10 World’s Most Admired Companies by "Fortune" magazine. Every day FedEx delivers for its customers with transportation and business solutions, serving more than 220 countries and territories around the globe. We can serve this global network due to our outstanding team of FedEx team members, who are tasked with making every FedEx experience outstanding.
   

  

 Our Philosophy
   

  

 The People\-Service\-Profit philosophy (P\-S\-P) describes the principles that govern every FedEx decision, policy, or activity. FedEx takes care of our people; they, in turn, deliver the impeccable service demanded by our customers, who reward us with the profitability necessary to secure our future. The essential element in making the People\-Service\-Profit philosophy such a positive force for the company is where we close the circle, and return these profits back into the business, and invest back in our people. Our success in the industry is attributed to our people. Through our P\-S\-P philosophy, we have a work environment that encourages team members to be innovative in delivering the highest possible quality of service to our customers. We care for their well\-being, and value their contributions to the company.
   

  

 Our Culture
   

  

 Our culture is important for many reasons, and we intentionally bring it to life through our behaviors, actions, and activities in every part of the world. The FedEx culture and values have been a cornerstone of our success and growth since we began in the early 1970’s. While other companies can copy our systems, infrastructure, and processes, our culture makes us unique and is often a differentiating factor as we compete and grow in today’s global marketplace.
